definitions.purpose: Creates the first recognised settlement centre and a shared point for warmth, cooking, light, meetings and early identity.

capacity.description: Supports a small camp gathering and one shared cooking/heating point; capacity scales with seating and cook attachments rather than creating housing.

jobs.description: guard or storyteller use points may be assigned

outputs.description: early warning point and settlement-centre anchor

construction.description: 2 stages: cleared site and fire ring; activation with fuel. Decorative seating and shelter are later additions.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected immediately when founding a camp or replacing a destroyed centre. Fails when flooded, smothered, out of fuel or unsafe from nearby fire hazards.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Outdoor, ventilated, reachable, clear of flammable blocks; optional shelter or windbreak; no utility network required.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Can anchor a temporary camp cluster, communal kitchen, village square, festival ground or ritual site; the campfire itself remains reusable.
definitions.culture_and_style: Stone rings, braziers, rune embers, communal hearths, spirit fires and portable fire pits are style variants.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must expose safe access, fire clearance, one cook position and one gathering zone. Decorative-only fires do not count.

definitions.purpose: Provides the first weather-protected sleeping space without pretending to be permanent housing.

capacity.description: Normally 1-2 residents or one compact household; harsh climates may reduce suitability without insulation or heat.

inputs.description: bedding and optional ground mat or heating fuel

construction.description: 3 stages: site/pegs; frame and cover; bedding/activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Chosen during founding, migration, disaster or temporary labour surges. Becomes strained when overcrowded, damaged, wet or seasonally unsuitable.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Requires reasonably dry ground, access and safe spacing from fires; terrain levelling should be minimal.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Worker/refugee shelter, primitive hut, expedition tent or culture-specific portable dwelling.
definitions.culture_and_style: Canvas, hide, woven reed, nomadic felt, leaf canopy and magical membrane variants.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must contain valid sleep markers, weatherproof cover, reachable entrance and no exposed dangerous blocks.

definitions.purpose: Establishes a visible project staging area where construction materials, scaffolds, tools and blueprint anchors can be reserved before a permanent warehouse exists.

capacity.description: Draft low shared capacity for one or two active early projects, determined by valid supply crates, material bays and scaffold markers.

outputs.description: temporary repair supply and construction progress feedback

construction.description: 3 stages: clear/mark site; place crates, bays and scaffold; activate project ledger and builder access.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required in the POC before staged NPC construction. Fails when stock is inaccessible, markers are buried/blocked, ownership is invalid or the active project moves beyond practical hauling range.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near the settlement centre or active project area on accessible ground. It requires a path and must not obstruct future roads or building parcels.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Construction depot, Small Storehouse, Village Warehouse or temporary mobile project camp.
definitions.culture_and_style: Timber yard, stone mason staging court, nomad pack camp, dwarven material alcove, fae living scaffold grove or magical floating supply rack.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must expose visible project stock, safe worker access, route/loading space and one valid project anchor. Decorative scaffold piles alone do not create reservation capacity.

definitions.purpose: Provides fast communal accommodation for builders, seasonal workers, refugees, evacuees or disaster survivors.

capacity.description: Usually 4-12 temporary residents; privacy and household compatibility are lower than permanent homes.

outputs.description: triage or registration capacity and reduced homelessness pressure

construction.description: 3-4 rapid stages with reusable modules and minimal decoration.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Triggered by migration, disaster, labour recruitment or housing loss. Penalised if kept as long-term housing without upgrades.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near storage, work sites or safe civic areas; must not block future permanent parcels.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Dormitory, longhouse, apartment, quarantine shelter or dismantling/reuse once crisis ends.
definitions.culture_and_style: Barracks, bunkhouse, communal pavilion, refugee cabins and magical emergency ward variants.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must meet minimum bed spacing, safe exits, access and climate protection. Decorative tents cannot claim shelter capacity.

definitions.purpose: Provides the first permanent, repairable home and proves the transition from camp to hamlet.

capacity.description: Normally 1-3 residents; one household; basic storage and heat/light support.

jobs.description: with optional micro work point such as mending or food preparation

outputs.description: household assignment and improved climate protection

construction.description: 4 stages: foundation; shell; roof/door; bedding and activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required when camp residents need permanent homes. Fails if roof, access, beds or climate protection are invalid.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Flat or minor-levelled parcel, road/path socket and safe drainage.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Small cottage, farmhouse, woodland cabin or culture-specific house family.
definitions.culture_and_style: Material palette, roof form, window style and plan may change; the functional household profile remains stable.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must be enclosed enough for local weather, reachable, contain approved beds and avoid blocked exits or internal hazards.

definitions.purpose: Standard permanent household building and the main test case for player-designed housing blueprints.

capacity.description: Usually 2-5 residents; one household; better privacy, storage and resilience than a hut.

jobs.description: optional home industry marker without replacing a dedicated workplace

outputs.description: spare-capacity potential and positive morale when maintained

construction.description: 5 stages: foundation; frame; shell; weatherproofing; furnishing/inspection.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected for permanent housing growth, replacement of huts or family formation. Loses contribution when overcrowded, damaged or inaccessible.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Residential parcel with safe access, drainage and required climate adaptation.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Farmhouse, townhouse/shop-house, larger cottage, assisted housing or culture-specific branch.
definitions.culture_and_style: Highly variable exterior and room arrangement; palettes and style kits should make cottages the main expression of local architecture.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Capacity comes from valid beds and room suitability, not footprint alone. Player designs must pass weather, access, fire and household checks.

definitions.purpose: Combines a household with nearby agricultural work, storage and oversight without merging all farm facilities into one abstract building.

capacity.description: Usually 3-6 residents and 1-3 farm workers; modest crop/tool storage.

outputs.description: local tool storage and reduced travel time to fields/barn

construction.description: 6 stages, with home shell activating before optional farm porch, storage or decorative finish.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when agriculture is important and worker travel is high. Underperforms without nearby productive parcels.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Adjacent to farm parcels, barn or orchard; may sit at cluster edge rather than centre.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Farmstead cluster, manor farm, irrigated estate or automated farm residence.
definitions.culture_and_style: Courtyard, longhouse, stilt farm, hill terrace, orchard lodge and living-wood farm variants.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must satisfy full housing checks and provide at least one agricultural work or storage marker; a house near a field is not automatically a farmhouse.

definitions.purpose: Provides dense early communal housing for cultures or settlements that prefer shared living and meals.

capacity.description: Usually 8-20 residents across several households or one extended household; shared hearth and storage.

outputs.description: efficient heating and communal meal support

construction.description: 6-7 stages; foundations/frame are substantial, while household areas may activate in phases.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Useful under rapid population growth, limited land or communal culture preference. Morale may fall if imposed on privacy-focused cultures.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Central or cluster parcel with strong path access and fire clearance.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Communal hall, dormitory, courtyard housing or apartment branch.
definitions.culture_and_style: Great hall, clan house, earth lodge, tree hall, cavern hall and nomadic communal pavilion variants.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must define household compatibility, exits, circulation and heating safety; simple bed spam does not create valid capacity.

definitions.purpose: Introduces compact mixed-use urban parcels with residence and a compatible public or productive ground floor.

capacity.description: Usually 3-6 residents plus 1-4 workplace or retail jobs.

inputs.description: Household provisions plus workplace inputs defined by the attached shop/work module

outputs.description: active streets and reduced travel demand

construction.description: 6-8 stages; shell can be shared while residence and shop activate separately.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when land value, street activity and mixed-use demand rise. Can fail through incompatible hazards, noise or blocked private access.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Street frontage in town or denser village centre; compatible neighbouring use and delivery access required.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Apartment house, merchant house, guild row, courtyard block or specialised urban branch.
definitions.culture_and_style: Timber-framed, stone arcade, bazaar courtyard, canal house, tower-house and magical vertical variants.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Player blueprint must separate household safety from public/work hazards and satisfy both attached functional profiles.

definitions.purpose: Provides high-capacity urban housing while creating service, evacuation and infrastructure requirements appropriate to cities.

capacity.description: Usually 12-40 residents in multiple households; exact capacity derives from valid units, beds, circulation and utilities.

outputs.description: efficient land use and district population support

construction.description: 8+ stages, often wing-by-wing; partial occupancy allowed only after inspected routes and utilities are complete.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected under urban housing pressure and limited parcels. Becomes unsafe or low-morale when services, exits or maintenance fail.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Urban district with road, safety, water/sanitation and emergency access expected by city stage.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Courtyard block, assisted housing, noble apartments, worker housing or magical vertical residence.
definitions.culture_and_style: Row blocks, courtyard compounds, cliff dwellings, cavern terraces, living towers and floating residential modules.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Capacity is denied for unreachable rooms, missing exits, unsafe vertical routes, invalid households or absent required city services.

definitions.purpose: Creates the first dependable renewable food source and a clear settlement project that reacts to soil, climate and labour.

capacity.description: Typical small plot supports part of 2-6 residents depending on crop, season, fertility and skill; several plots combine into a farmstead.

inputs.description: water access or rainfall and optional fertiliser

construction.description: 3 stages: clear/prepare; plant/irrigate; first operational crop cycle. Growth is not construction progress.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required when provisions fall below reserve targets. Can lie fallow through season, crop rotation or labour shortage rather than being “broken.”
planner.placement_and_utilities: Valid soil, light, slope and climate; reachable from storage and protected from trampling or hostile animals.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Irrigated/terraced farm, orchard, herb garden, greenhouse or automated farm.
definitions.culture_and_style: Field geometry, crop family, terraces, raised beds, paddies, fungal beds and magical cultivation vary by biome/culture.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must contain enough valid cultivated cells and access. Decorative gardens do not count unless configured as edible production.

definitions.purpose: Expands agriculture where water control, slopes or higher yields justify infrastructure investment.

capacity.description: Usually supports a meaningful village food share; capacity depends on cultivated area and water reliability rather than one fixed output.

inputs.description: repair materials and optional fertiliser or mana support

outputs.description: Higher or more reliable crop output
specialty crops and reduced drought/slope penalties

construction.description: 5-7 stages: survey; retaining/levelling; channels; soil; planting; inspection.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Chosen for food pressure, poor flat land, drought risk or agricultural specialisation. Pauses if water rights or network capacity fail.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Slope-appropriate or water-connected terrain; must not create uncontrolled flooding or block roads.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Farmstead cluster, automated farm, magical greenhouse or regional irrigation network.
definitions.culture_and_style: Rice terraces, step gardens, canal fields, desert qanat farms, cavern fungus terraces and ley-fed gardens.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Requires continuous water logic, reachable terraces and stable retaining/foundation rules; visual channels alone are insufficient.

definitions.purpose: Protects feed, tools, harvests and livestock support functions without replacing the separate granary or animal yard systems.

capacity.description: Small-to-medium farm storage plus shelter for a limited livestock group or equipment set, depending on blueprint profile.

outputs.description: farm-tool access and reduced spoilage/weather loss

construction.description: 5 stages: foundation; frame; walls; roof/doors; bays/storage activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when farm storage, animals or harvest handling are bottlenecks. Fire, pests and feed shortage are key failure risks.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near fields, paddock and farmhouse; downwind/away from dense housing where appropriate.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Stable/paddock, specialised livestock barn, farmstead cluster or automated feed store.
definitions.culture_and_style: Timber barn, stone byre, reed loft, cavern pens, living-root shelter and climate-sealed variants.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must separate safe storage and animal/equipment circulation; storage capacity comes from marked zones and containers.

definitions.purpose: Creates protected staple reserves and makes seasonal food security visible and measurable.

capacity.description: Provides protected dry-food capacity sized by containers/marked volume; supports reserve-days calculations rather than producing food.

jobs.description: may be unstaffed at small scale

outputs.description: project/emergency reserve separation and clearer provision forecasting

construction.description: 5 stages: raised/foundation; shell; roof; storage bins; sealing/inspection.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required at Village when food production exceeds safe household storage or seasonal reserve targets rise. Fails through moisture, pests, fire or untracked access.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Dry, raised or drained site with guarded access; near farms and kitchen but separated from fire risks.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Specialised silo/depot (20D), town reserve house, automated food warehouse or magical cold/dry vault.
definitions.culture_and_style: Raised granaries, stone silos, clay bins, cliff stores, fungal vaults and rune-sealed reserve houses.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must contain valid protected food storage and access; empty decorative towers do not provide reserve capacity.

definitions.purpose: Converts stored ingredients into safe batch meals and provides an early communal service without simulating every bite as a separate player task.

capacity.description: One or more cook stations serving a small hamlet; throughput depends on cooks, fuel, inputs and meal storage.

outputs.description: social mealtime and reduced foodborne-risk when operational

construction.description: 5 stages: shell; hearth/ventilation; work surfaces; storage/water; furniture/inspection.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required when settlement grows beyond household cooking or raw-food dependence becomes unsafe/inefficient. Pauses from fuel, water, cook or ingredient shortage.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Central and accessible, near food storage and water, separated from flammable/unsanitary uses.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Bakery/food workshop, tavern/inn kitchen, preserving house or district food hall.
definitions.culture_and_style: Communal hearth, outdoor cookhouse, clay oven court, feast hall kitchen, steam kitchen and mana-heated kitchen.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must provide safe cook path, ventilation, input/output and water logic; a decorative hearth alone is not a kitchen.

definitions.purpose: Processes grain and similar crops into higher-value cooking inputs using mechanical, water, wind or powered milling.

capacity.description: Throughput depends on mill mechanism, power and worker; supports one village-scale grain chain.

construction.description: 6 stages: foundation; mill structure; mechanism; power connection; storage; inspection.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when grain surplus and kitchen/bakery demand justify processing. Stops cleanly on blocked output or lost power.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near water/wind/power opportunity or connected network; noise and moving parts should be considered near housing.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Powered mill, industrial food plant (20E) or district grain complex.
definitions.culture_and_style: Watermill, windmill, animal mill, hand quern hall, rune mill and compact urban mill.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must include approved processing mechanism and power/input/output links; visual wheel without functional connection does not count.

definitions.purpose: Produces bread, prepared foods or a culture-specific staple beyond basic communal meals.

capacity.description: Small specialist workshop serving village demand; throughput depends on recipe, worker, fuel and processed inputs.

construction.description: 5-6 stages; functional oven and work surfaces activate before final storefront decoration.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected for food variety, trade, morale or population demand; not a required survival building if communal kitchen capacity is sufficient.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near market or kitchen/storage route with safe fire and delivery access.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Tavern kitchen, preserving house, urban food hall or industrial food plant.
definitions.culture_and_style: Bread ovens, noodle house, smoke-cookhouse, sweetmaker, fungal bakery, spirit-kitchen and magical confectioner.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must satisfy recipe station, ventilation and storage markers; player designs may be workshop-only or mixed shop-house when safe.

definitions.purpose: Extends reserve life through drying, smoking, salting, pickling, fermentation, chilling or magical preservation.

capacity.description: Town-scale preservation batches; increases usable reserve days and reduces seasonal waste rather than producing food from nothing.

jobs.description: alchemist or cold-store keeper depending on method

construction.description: 6-7 stages with process equipment and sanitary inspection before operation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected for seasonal surplus, long routes, winter risk or trade. Can create health risk if sanitation, temperature or recipe control fails.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near food logistics and water; method-specific smoke, waste, cold or magic safety rules apply.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Cold store, industrial food plant, magical preservation vault or regional reserve complex.
definitions.culture_and_style: Smokehouse, salt house, fermentation cellar, icehouse, sun-drying court and time-rune pantry.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must include a supported preservation method and hygienic flow; generic storage does not claim preservation bonus.

definitions.purpose: Provides safe animal housing, feeding, breeding or transport-animal support as one linked facility family.

capacity.description: Draft range: 2-8 large mounts/work animals or a larger number of small livestock, depending on marked stalls and grazing space.

outputs.description: manure/by-products and transport or farming capacity

construction.description: 5-6 stages: fence/paddock; shelter; stalls; feed/water; work points; inspection.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when owned animals lack capacity or transport/farming demand rises. Welfare and escape risk worsen if overcrowded or underfed.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Accessible edge parcel with suitable ground, drainage and separation from dense housing where appropriate.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Large stable, caravan yard, beast-training ground, sanctuary or automated feed system.
definitions.culture_and_style: Open corrals, stone stables, cliff roosts, underground pens, living enclosures and magical creature wards.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Capacity derives from valid stalls/pens and access; decorative fences do not create animal service.

definitions.purpose: Creates a water-dependent food and trade branch without forcing inland settlements to build irrelevant structures.

capacity.description: Output depends on water biome, stock pressure, boats/nets, season and workers; small versions serve a hamlet.

outputs.description: trade goods and optional transport access

construction.description: 4-6 stages: shore works; deck/shelter; moorings; storage/work; inspection.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Only eligible when local water and ecology support it. Overfishing, storms, pollution or hostile water creatures can reduce output.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Valid fishable water, stable shore/depth, safe access and non-conflicting route; can be river, lake, coast or cavern water.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Harbour fishery, hatchery, preserving house link or culture-specific aquatic farm.
definitions.culture_and_style: River jetty, coastal pier, stilt village dock, ice fish house, cavern platform and floating kelp farm.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must connect to valid water and safe work/landing points; decorative docks do not generate fish.

definitions.purpose: Provides the first formal treatment service, medicine storage and recovery capacity.

capacity.description: One healer work point and 1-2 recovery beds; sufficient for routine village injuries, not a major outbreak or battle.

inputs.description: fuel/light and optional herbs or magical components

outputs.description: medicine crafting or dispensing and health reassurance

construction.description: 5 stages: shell; clean interior; treatment station; medicine/recovery; inspection.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required when population, injury history or stage expectations exceed informal care. Becomes overloaded when patients exceed staff/beds/medicine.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Quiet, accessible central site near water and emergency routes; separated from major pollution or industry.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Clinic/infirmary, hospital campus (20F), quarantine shelter or magical healing branch (20E).
definitions.culture_and_style: Herbal hut, surgeon house, clan healer lodge, spirit clinic, alchemical dispensary and rune-healing room.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must have treatment, storage, clean access and recovery capacity; decorative herb shelves do not create health service.

definitions.purpose: Expands treatment, triage and short-term recovery for a town, military site or dense district.

capacity.description: Several treatment/recovery positions with triage and medicine support; exact capacity derives from staff, beds and utilities.

jobs.description: apothecary and optional cleaner or porter

outputs.description: outbreak detection and emergency response support

construction.description: 6-8 stages; clean utilities and inspected care routes required before activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when healer hut is overloaded, district access is poor or threat/industry raises injury load. Fails through staff, medicine, sanitation or access shortage.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Road-connected service area with reliable water, sanitation and low hazard exposure.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Hospital complex (20F), specialised cleansing clinic (20E), hospice or military infirmary.
definitions.culture_and_style: Courtyard clinic, monastic infirmary, field-surgery hall, bath-clinic, alchemical clinic and mana-assisted infirmary.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Player design must meet bed spacing, clean routes, staff access, utility and evacuation rules appropriate to capacity.

definitions.purpose: Provides city-scale diagnosis, surgery, recovery, maternity, emergency care, isolation and disaster capacity by coordinating multiple specialist rooms or buildings around shared utilities, records and logistics.

capacity.description: Draft treatment, bed, surgery, isolation and emergency capacity is derived from validated rooms, staff, medicine, clean water, sanitation, power or mana where required, route access and condition. Decorative beds or empty towers add no service.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when city population, travel distance, casualty history, disease risk or specialist demand exceeds clinics. It underperforms when staff, medicine, water, sanitation, access or clean separation fail.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Central enough for emergency access but separated from heavy pollution, uncontrolled portals and siege chokepoints. Requires reliable roads, water, sanitation, food, storage, emergency power and room for future wards.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Regional Hospital, Teaching Hospital, Military Hospital, Magical Healing Campus, Corruption-Cleansing Institute or disaster-response medical centre.
definitions.culture_and_style: Courtyard hospital, monastic healing campus, dwarven underground infirmary, fae restorative grove, desert shade-and-water hospital, arcane clinical tower or distributed neighbourhood health campus.

definitions.purpose: Provides flexible isolation, disaster shelter or evacuation capacity without creating a permanent always-on “panic” need.

capacity.description: Typically 4-16 temporary occupants, with capacity profile chosen as quarantine, disaster shelter or mixed emergency use.

outputs.description: safe evacuation capacity and reduced outbreak/disaster spread

construction.description: Rapid 4-6 stages; may reuse modular shelters and activate by wing.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Triggered by outbreak, refugee arrival, disaster warning, damaged housing or event requirement. Dormant when not needed and should not consume heavy staffing.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Accessible but separable from dense population; safe from the hazard it is intended to answer.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Clinic wing, refugee centre, permanent emergency bunker (20C) or dismantling/reuse after crisis.
definitions.culture_and_style: Isolation cabins, monastery ward, earth shelter, ship quarantine pier, warded pavilion and portable relief hall.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Mode-specific checks apply; a quarantine design must prevent uncontrolled circulation, while a storm shelter must meet hazard protection.

definitions.purpose: Provides a culture-neutral functional slot for worship, assembly, remembrance, ritual, counselling or shared identity.

capacity.description: Small gathering of roughly 6-20 users, depending on seating/standing markers; service depends on events and cultural compatibility.

construction.description: 5 stages: site/foundation; hall/shell; weatherproofing; focal furnishings; activation/dedication.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected for morale, identity, story or governance need. Should not penalise cultures whose equivalent is a grove, plaza or ancestor house.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Accessible civic or residential centre; belief-specific versions may have orientation, landscape or mana requirements.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Cultural hall/theatre, temple/monastery via 20G or ritual/magic facility via 20E.
definitions.culture_and_style: Shrine, ancestor room, clan hall, spirit grove, civic lodge, meditation garden and secular meeting hall are equivalent profiles.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must provide a valid community function and gathering capacity; no universal religion object is mandatory.

definitions.purpose: Combines public meals, social activity and optional guest lodging, supporting local life and travel without becoming a universal survival requirement.

capacity.description: Small village versions serve a gathering crowd and 0-8 guest beds; tavern-only and inn profiles are both valid.

jobs.description: brewer or stablehand depending on modules

inputs.description: cleaning supplies and optional trade goods

construction.description: 6-7 stages; public room may activate before guest wing or decoration.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected under visitor, trade, morale or meal-capacity demand. Can increase noise, crime or fire risk if poorly managed.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Village centre, road junction or caravan route with delivery and noise compatibility.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Coaching inn, guild lodge, city hotel, caravanserai or culture-specific hospitality branch.
definitions.culture_and_style: Alehouse, tea house, feast lodge, caravan inn, bath inn, mushroom tavern and magical traveller house.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must distinguish guest beds from permanent housing and meet kitchen/public/escape rules; an inn is not required for every village.

definitions.purpose: Provides shared washing, bathing and linen services where density and culture justify them, without creating individual hygiene bars.

capacity.description: Town service capacity based on water, heat, staff and wash stations; improves health risk and morale at district level.

construction.description: 6-8 stages; utilities and drainage must be commissioned before use.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when town density, clinic needs, culture or sanitation pressure justify it. Does not become a mandatory personal need meter.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Reliable water/drainage utility, suitable district access and separation from contaminated industry.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Public baths, healing baths, steam house, district laundry or magical cleansing spa.
definitions.culture_and_style: Roman-style baths, sauna, hot spring, river washhouse, steam cave, ritual cleansing pools and rune-heated bath.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Requires functional water, heat and drainage; privacy and accessibility rules depend on culture/world settings.

definitions.purpose: Provides flexible outdoor or semi-covered space for festivals, markets, ceremonies, meetings, training and temporary events.

capacity.description: Variable gathering capacity defined by clear area, entrances and event layout; no permanent daily staffing required.

jobs.description: guards and temporary workers during events

construction.description: 3-5 stages: clear/grade; paths/boundary; stage or sockets; lighting/decoration; approval.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected for morale, culture, tourism or event requirements; remains useful between events as public space.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Central green, edge field or civic plaza with safe crowd access and minimal route conflict.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Civic square, tournament ground, cultural precinct or district festival venue.
definitions.culture_and_style: Village green, dance circle, feast field, market court, floating platform, cavern forum and seasonal ritual meadow.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must provide safe crowd flow and event sockets; empty inaccessible terrain does not count.

definitions.purpose: Handles remembrance, burial/cremation or culture-specific death rites, making loss visible without simulating graphic detail.

capacity.description: Provides rite and memorial capacity; burial plots, crypts or alternatives depend on culture and land availability.

jobs.description: undertaker or historian as culture requires

inputs.description: fuel for cremation where used and optional offerings

outputs.description: safe body handling and cultural continuity

construction.description: 4-6 stages, expandable by plots or memorial modules.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Triggered by deaths, cultural requirements or memorial events. Lack of an accepted rite can prolong morale penalties, but not every culture needs graves.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Culture-appropriate quiet site, safe drainage and access; may be outside walls, in crypts, gardens or sacred landscapes.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Mausoleum, remembrance garden, ancestor hall, catacomb or capital monument.
definitions.culture_and_style: Cemetery, cremation garden, ancestor wall, sky platform, mushroom grove, ossuary, memory crystal hall and spirit forest.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must use culture-approved body/rite profile and safe access; player designs cannot claim incompatible rites by decoration alone.

definitions.purpose: Supports performances, education, civic gatherings, exhibitions and culture-specific public life at town scale.

capacity.description: Medium-to-large audience with backstage/service capacity; output depends on staff, programme and access rather than passive existence.

construction.description: 7-9 stages; hall shell and assembly function may activate before advanced stage equipment/decor.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected after basic needs stabilise or when culture/story/tourism demands rise. Provides little benefit if permanently unstaffed or inaccessible.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Town civic or cultural district with strong transport and safety access.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Grand theatre, museum/gallery, civic complex, festival precinct or capital cultural wonder.
definitions.culture_and_style: Amphitheatre, clan saga hall, masked theatre, music court, memory gallery, dream theatre and floating performance arena.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must satisfy crowd, exit, stage/focal and service requirements; player design may choose theatre, gallery, lecture hall or mixed cultural profile.

definitions.purpose: Creates a controlled forestry job site with tool access, log staging and cutting-zone rules instead of letting a decorative woodpile generate timber.

capacity.description: Draft small-team capacity: 1-4 foresters or lumberjacks, one active cutting zone and a limited log staging area. Output depends on reachable trees, regrowth policy, tools and hauling.

jobs.description: hauler and optional surveyor or nature specialist

outputs.description: may also reserve seed stock or mark protected trees

construction.description: 4 stages: clear and mark site; tool/supply shelter; log staging; activation and cutting-zone approval.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when timber demand exceeds imports or casual gathering. Output falls when the zone is depleted, unsafe, inaccessible, overprotected or lacks tools/hauling.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Forest edge or managed woodland with road/path access; must bind to an allowed forestry zone and respect protected, sacred or exhausted areas.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Sawmill link, forester lodge, managed plantation, cart loading yard or magical living-wood branch through 20G/20E.
definitions.culture_and_style: Open timber camp, woodland lodge, cliff rope-yard, underground fungal wood works, living-tree stewardship site or nomadic cutting camp.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must include a real zone anchor, safe storage and delivery route. Decorative trees or logs do not create resources; player designs cannot claim forestry output without valid nearby resource access.

definitions.purpose: Processes logs into consistent planks, beams, boards and by-products with better yield and throughput than hand crafting.

capacity.description: One or more saw stations with draft village throughput based on staff, power method and input/output buffers. It improves conversion efficiency but never creates timber.

inputs.description: mechanical/fuel/water power where required and recipe knowledge

construction.description: 6 stages: foundation; frame; intake/storage; saw mechanism; power and safety; commissioning. Manual or water-powered variants may merge stages.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when building demand, timber waste or carpenter bottlenecks justify it. Pauses with no logs, dull/broken blades, blocked output, lost power or unsafe machinery.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near timber storage and road/water power access; requires noise, blade and fire separation from dense housing.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Powered sawmill, carpenter complex, automated lumber plant through 20E or culture-specific precision mill.
definitions.culture_and_style: Waterwheel mill, hand-frame saw house, dwarven gear saw, fae shaping grove, desert wind saw or mana-guided precision mill.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must resolve a supported saw process, operator access, guarded blade zone and separated input/output. A static saw prop cannot provide processing bonuses.

definitions.purpose: Combines a controlled stone extraction face with staging, sorting and basic stone supply for roads, walls and building projects.

capacity.description: Draft 2-8 workers across one bound quarry zone; output depends on exposed stone, tool tier, safe benches, hauling and local geology.

inputs.description: repair supplies and optional blasting or magic permits at later tiers

construction.description: 5-7 stages: survey and boundary; access ramp; work face; storage/spoil; loading; safety inspection; optional crane.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Eligible only where usable stone exists. Selected for sustained construction demand; output falls with exhausted faces, unsafe slopes, tool shortage, blocked hauling or flooding.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Valid rock face or shallow deposit with slope and collapse checks; should avoid undermining roads, homes, sacred ground or waterworks.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Deep quarry, stone-cutting complex, automated quarry through 20E or culture-specific underground hall.
definitions.culture_and_style: Open pit, stepped cliff quarry, underground chamber, river-stone works, crystal-cut yard or giant-carved stone face.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: A player blueprint must bind to real stone terrain, define safe extraction and spoil areas, and preserve reachable work paths. It cannot mine arbitrary protected blocks.

definitions.purpose: Provides a flexible earth-material extraction family for clay, sand, gravel, salt or similar local deposits without duplicating one building for every material.

capacity.description: Small crew and one bound deposit zone; yield and hazards use the selected resource profile.

jobs.description: hauler and optional potter or mason

outputs.description: salt or related raw material plus rejects and washed grades

construction.description: 4-6 stages depending on material: survey; access; extraction area; processing/staging; drainage; inspection.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when local material demand and deposit quality justify operation. Flooding, contamination, depleted layers, unstable walls or no hauling can pause it.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Only eligible on a valid deposit with erosion, flood, collapse and protected-water checks.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Pottery/kiln supply chain, brickworks, glassworks, salt house or automated earthworks through 20E.
definitions.culture_and_style: River clay pit, dune works, salt pan, cavern silt basin, volcanic ash yard or magically separated earthworks.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must use a supported resource profile and real deposit. Visual sand or clay decoration alone does not create output.

definitions.purpose: Creates controlled access, staffing, storage and safety for an underground mine network while leaving the actual ore inside the voxel world.

capacity.description: Draft 1-6 miners using one connected mine zone; capacity depends on reachable headings, ventilation, support, tool tier, light and hauling.

jobs.description: hauler and guard where threats exist

inputs.description: repair materials and optional pumps or ventilation

outputs.description: cave resources and underground route access

construction.description: 6 stages: survey; portal supports; access tunnel; storage/tool area; lighting/safety; commissioning and mine-zone binding.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Only eligible with useful underground resources or strategic access. Can pause after collapse, flooding, gas, hostile occupation, missing supports, no tools or blocked hauling.
planner.placement_and_utilities: At a valid cave, shaft or carved route with stable terrain, surface access and no ownership conflict.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Deep mine complex, minecart depot, ore sorting yard, automated mine through 20E or culture-specific hold entrance.
definitions.culture_and_style: Timber portal, stone adit, dwarven gate, desert sink mine, fae root tunnel, ice shaft or rune-stabilised crystal entrance.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must connect to a real mine volume and safe reachable route. Decorative tunnel mouths do not generate ore or teleport miners to abstract resources nearby.

definitions.display_name: Mine Shaft or Deep Mine Complex
definitions.purpose: Supports deeper extraction through lifts, ventilation, pumps, rails, support crews and specialised safety systems.

capacity.description: Multiple crews, levels and resource headings; throughput is limited by lift/rail capacity, ventilation, power, maintenance and danger.

outputs.description: Large volumes of ore and stone
survey data and strategic underground access

construction.description: 8-12 stages built as subprojects: shaft collar; lift; ventilation; first level; loading; pumps; safety; expansion levels.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when shallow sources cannot meet demand and technology, specialists, capital and safety capacity exist. Major incidents can close levels without destroying the whole complex.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Valid deep resource body and geologically stable shaft location with strong road/logistics access and risk permissions.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Automated deep mine, underground industrial district, dimensional bore or culture-specific mountain hold through 20E/20F/20G.
definitions.culture_and_style: Timber shaft, steel headframe, dwarven lift hall, golem-mined cavern, leyline bore or void-shielded deep works.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Player plans must prove shaft clearance, emergency egress, ventilation/pump coverage and loading logistics. Deep output requires actual generated resource access.

definitions.purpose: Grades, separates, stores and prepares raw ore batches before smelting, trade or specialist processing.

capacity.description: One or more sorting tables and stock bays; improves batch consistency and can recover minor by-products based on skill and tools.

jobs.description: hauler and optional merchant or smith

inputs.description: labels and optional water or mechanical separation

construction.description: 4-6 stages: level yard; stock bays; sorting stations; secure storage; drainage/dust; activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when ore volume, grade variation, smelter efficiency or trade value justify it. Blocked bins, absent sorters or contamination reduce benefit.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Between mine transport and furnace/warehouse routes; requires dust, runoff and theft controls.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Crusher/concentrator through 20E, assay office, rail loading yard or magical purity laboratory.
definitions.culture_and_style: Hand-picking yard, water sluice, dwarven assay court, crystal resonance sorter or goblin scrap grading yard.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must expose distinct intake, processing and grade outputs; a single generic stockpile cannot claim sorting efficiency.

definitions.purpose: Converts wood or approved biomass into reliable early fuel and stores it safely for homes, kitchens, kilns and smithies.

capacity.description: Small batch kilns or clamps plus protected fuel storage; throughput depends on wood supply, burn time, staff and fire safety.

outputs.description: fuel stock and possible wood vinegar/tar at advanced variants

construction.description: 4-6 stages: clear/firebreak; raw store; kiln/clamp; finished store; safety equipment; activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when fuel demand, winter risk or smithing grows. Fire, rain, wood shortage, blocked storage or unattended burns can interrupt production.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Downwind or edge parcel away from dense housing, with road access and strong fire separation.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Fuel depot through 20D, coke/industrial fuel plant through 20E, alchemical charcoal works or culture-specific kiln.
definitions.culture_and_style: Earth mound, brick retort, forest charcoal camp, underground smokeless kiln, volcanic burner or rune-sealed clean kiln.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must include supported conversion process, firebreak and segregated raw/finished stock. A decorative kiln does not produce fuel.

definitions.purpose: Extracts raw mana crystal or related magical deposits while preserving purity, controlling instability and exposing the resource as a physical civilisation input rather than an abstract currency.

capacity.description: Draft yield is determined by the bound deposit, grade, purity, extraction method, staffing, tools, power, stabilisation and safe output capacity. Hand-mined veins and long-term extraction nodes use the same resource-conservation rules.

jobs.description: surveyor and guard where the deposit attracts threats

inputs.description: optional mechanical or mana power and any realm-specific protective supplies

outputs.description: unstable residue and occasional rare catalysts according to the resource definition

construction.description: 6-8 stages: survey and claim; safe access; supports and work face; staging/storage; stabilisation and power; inspection; optional expansion modules.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when a known deposit, mage specialist and sustained mana demand justify the risk. It pauses or degrades when the node is exhausted, unsupported, contaminated, inaccessible, overloaded or legally restricted.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Requires a verified magical deposit and safe route. Placement must account for cave support, mana leakage, creature attraction, water, corruption, settlement distance and future extraction footprint.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Crystal Mine Office, Stabilised Extractor, Automated Mana Mine, Purification Annex, Deep Crystal Works or realm-specific extraction branch.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must bind to a real deposit, expose reachable extraction and output markers, preserve exact yield, define hazard/stabilisation zones and prevent decorative crystals from granting production.

definitions.purpose: Scales bulk extraction from a verified long-term deposit using powered machinery, logistics and specialist maintenance without creating infinite resources or deleting the need for NPC oversight.

capacity.description: Draft throughput depends on deposit reserve, machine heads, power, maintenance, output buffers, route capacity, worker supervision and environmental constraints.

outputs.description: survey depletion data and optional rare finds

construction.description: 8-10 stages, with a manual or low-power extraction phase activating before full machines, sorting and heavy logistics.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when manual extraction cannot meet verified demand and the settlement has power, maintenance and safe logistics. It pauses on depleted reserve, no power, blocked output or unsafe instability.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Requires a large deposit or quarry zone, heavy access and safe separation from housing. Noise, pollution, subsidence, corruption and faction claims affect suitability.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Deep Automated Mine, Precision Quarry, Arcane Extractor, Regional Mining Complex or dimensional resource branch.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must bind to a finite or regenerating resource record, prove machine clearance, power, control, maintenance, output and waste routes, and preserve depletion across save/load and LOD.

definitions.purpose: Produces wooden building components, furniture, repairs and blueprint parts from processed timber.

capacity.description: Draft 1-3 carpenters, one main bench and limited assembly space; throughput scales with tools, skill, sawmill support and stock.

construction.description: 6 stages: foundation; shell; material store; benches and tools; output and loading; inspection. Basic repair work may activate before full furnishing.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required by Village stage or an equivalent building-component provider. Pauses with no timber, missing tools, blocked output, no carpenter or unsafe machinery.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Accessible workshop parcel near timber storage and builder supply routes; fire and saw safety required.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Joinery shop, furniture guild, sawmill complex, machine-assisted woodworks or living-wood workshop through 20E or 20G.
definitions.culture_and_style: Open timber yard, guild joinery, dwarven precision shop, fae living-wood studio, ship carpenter or clockwork woodworks.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must provide a valid workbench, safe material flow and input or output capacity. Player designs may combine with housing or a shopfront only when hazards and routes are separated.

definitions.purpose: Shapes stone into construction blocks, road pieces, walls, monuments and repair materials.

capacity.description: Draft 1-4 masons with several cutting or carving stations and heavy stock bays; output depends on stone supply, tools and hauling.

outputs.description: carved blocks and rubble or by-products

construction.description: 5-7 stages: level yard; stock bays; shelter; workstations; water or dust control; loading; inspection.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required for sustained stone construction or equivalent imported supply. Pauses with no stone, broken tools, blocked heavy access or unsafe stockpiles.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Edge artisan or industrial parcel with heavy-cart access, noise or dust separation and stable ground.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Stoneworks, sculpture atelier, roadworks depot, mechanised cutter through 20E or monumental works through 20F.
definitions.culture_and_style: Open yard, covered carving hall, dwarven stone hall, desert adobe and stone court, giant-scale cutter or rune-guided sculpting yard.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must provide heavy-material circulation, safe work clearances and true input or output staging; decorative stone piles do not create masonry capacity.

definitions.purpose: Provides tools, fittings, repairs and basic guard equipment, making metal progression and village maintenance visible.

capacity.description: Draft 1-2 smiths plus an apprentice, with one forge and anvil line; output depends on fuel, ingots, tools, recipes, ventilation and skill.

construction.description: 7 stages: foundation; heat-safe shell; chimney; forge; anvil and quench; stores and output; inspection and activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required by Village stage unless trade reliably supplies tools and repairs. Pauses without a smith, fuel, metal, tools, safe ventilation or output capacity.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Road-accessible artisan edge with fire separation, water and nearby fuel or metal logistics.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Town forge, armourer or weaponsmith specialisation, foundry link through 20E or rune forge branch through 20E.
definitions.culture_and_style: Open village smithy, dwarven forge hall, nomad wagon forge, volcanic forge, fae cold-forge or water-powered hammer shop.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must include a heat-safe work triangle, ventilation, quench and protected stores. A decorative forge cannot produce metal goods or count as a smithy.

definitions.purpose: Turns clay and similar earth materials into vessels, tiles, bricks, storage goods and culture products.

capacity.description: One kiln and several preparation stations; batch output depends on clay, fuel, drying time, skill and firing control.

outputs.description: storage containers and ceramic trade goods

construction.description: 5-7 stages: yard or foundation; preparation; drying; kiln and chimney; stores; firing inspection.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when storage containers, tiles, brick demand or cultural trade justify it. Firing can fail with wet wares, wrong fuel, poor skill or a damaged kiln.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near clay supply and water, with smoke or fire separation and road access for fragile goods.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Brickworks, glass and ceramic complex, porcelain studio, magical kiln or industrial materials plant through 20E.
definitions.culture_and_style: Open pottery court, cliff kiln, subterranean ceramic hall, sun-fired adobe works, dragon-heat kiln or rune-temperature kiln.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must include a valid kiln cycle and drying or handling path; decorative pots do not create production.

definitions.purpose: Processes fibre and cloth into clothing, sacks, bedding, banners, sails and cultural textiles.

capacity.description: Draft 1-4 workers across spinning, weaving and sewing stations; modules may specialise while sharing one functional definition.

construction.description: 5-7 stages depending on modules; basic sewing may activate before loom or dye additions.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected for clothing resilience, sacks and logistics, morale or culture goods, uniforms or trade. Pauses with missing fibre, tools, patterns, staff or blocked outputs.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Artisan or residential-compatible parcel; dyeing requires water, drainage and clean or dirty separation.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Textile mill through 20E, fashion house, banner guild, sail loft or magical thread workshop.
definitions.culture_and_style: Longhouse loom room, guild tailor, desert dye court, spider-silk atelier, living-fibre studio or rune-embroidered workshop.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Capacity derives from actual supported stations. Player mixed-use designs must separate dyes, public shop and living routes where needed.

definitions.purpose: Processes hides into leather and finished goods while explicitly managing odour, wastewater and contamination risk.

capacity.description: Draft 1-4 workers with dirty tanning and cleaner finishing zones; batch output depends on hides, reagents, water and time.

construction.description: 6-8 stages: drainage; shell; dirty vats; drying; clean workshop; stores; safety and sanitation inspection.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when hides and leather demand justify cost. Health penalties can arise from failed drainage, contamination, overcrowded vats or poor separation.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Downstream or edge industrial parcel with drainage, odour separation, water and safe waste handling.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Leather guild, saddlery, armour workshop, chemical tannery through 20E or magical hide treatment.
definitions.culture_and_style: Bark tannery, desert salt yard, underground fungal tannery, alchemical hideworks, beast-clan leather lodge or rune-cleansing tannery.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must prove dirty-to-clean flow, water and waste treatment; a generic crafting table cannot claim tanning capacity.

definitions.purpose: Produces high-heat construction materials such as glass, bricks, tiles and specialised blocks through one profile-selected facility family.

capacity.description: Town-scale batch furnaces and forming lines; the selected profile controls inputs, temperature, hazards, outputs and required skill.

construction.description: 7-9 stages; furnace commissioning and safety inspection precede production.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when urban construction, windows, laboratories, bottles or trade justify it. Can be disabled by fuel shortage, a damaged furnace, unsafe heat, no specialist or blocked cooling and output.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Industrial edge with heavy logistics, high-heat separation, water and emissions or waste controls.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Industrial materials plant through 20E, crystal glassworks, enchanted lensworks or regional brick complex.
definitions.culture_and_style: Roman-style glasshouse, desert sun glassworks, dwarven furnace hall, volcanic brickworks, crystal blower or mana-flame kiln.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Player blueprint must select a supported production profile and include the complete heat and handling path; one structure may contain both only if capacity and safety are validated separately.

definitions.purpose: Processes large metal batches, alloys and heavy structural components for town industry, fortifications, machines, rails and civilisation-scale projects.

capacity.description: Draft batch and throughput values depend on furnaces, heat source, fuel/power, material quality, ventilation, staffing, moulds, cooling and output storage.

construction.description: 8-10 stages: heavy foundations; shell and chimneys; furnace/casting line; power/fuel; cooling/ventilation; buffers; safety; activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when metal demand, machine production, defence or megaprojects exceed village smithy capacity. Output pauses safely when buffers, cooling, fuel or staffing fail.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Industrial district with heavy roads, water/cooling or equivalent, strong fire separation and room for waste/expansion. It should not be embedded in dense housing without advanced safeguards.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Steelworks, Precision Foundry, Automated Foundry, Arcane Alloy Works, Mythril Forge Annex or regional industrial complex.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must prove complete heat/material flow, safe worker circulation, ventilation/cooling, waste handling, maintenance access and authoritative batch transactions.

definitions.purpose: Builds, repairs and upgrades machine components, power parts, transport modules and automation systems while supporting NPC engineers and maintenance crews.

capacity.description: Draft assembly slots, repair queues and quality are determined by benches, tooling, specialist skill, component stock, power, precision and maintenance.

construction.description: 6-8 stages: shell; benches/storage; tooling; power/test zone; safety; specialist activation; optional annexes.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when the settlement owns several machines, suffers repair delays or unlocks advanced automation. It underperforms without specialist skill, precision tools, power or component stock.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Connected to industry and logistics but accessible to village repair crews. Noise and heavy testing require separation from homes unless culturally adapted.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Engineering Hall, Precision Machine Shop, Magitech Workshop, Golem Component Annex or Factory Design Office.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must contain reachable work and test markers, real component buffers, maintenance access, declared power needs and safe clearance for the largest supported assembly.

definitions.purpose: Combines smithing, rune inscription, mana control and specialist knowledge to create enchanted tools, gear, conduits, ward parts and magitech components.

capacity.description: Draft inscription and forging capacity depends on forge quality, rune stations, mana purity, specialist skill, stabilisation, item quality and safe output storage.

outputs.description: residue and occasional failed/junk outputs under risky recipes

construction.description: 7-9 stages, with mundane smithing usable before mana systems, rune stations and advanced enchantment activate.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when a trained specialist, rune knowledge, mana supply and demand for enchanted equipment exist. It can shut down on instability, impurity, ward failure or illegal recipe use.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Town artisan or magical district with road, fuel/heat, mana and safe separation. Forbidden enchantments may require restricted ownership and law checks.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Arcane Alloy Forge, Mythril Rune Forge, Culture-Specific Enchanted Smithy, Forbidden Forge or city magitech works.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must prove mundane forge safety plus mana flow, rune work zone, stabilisation, protected testing, ownership and recipe/risk declarations.

definitions.purpose: Creates flexible vendor slots for local exchange, rotating markets and temporary commerce without inventing infinite stock.

capacity.description: Draft 2-8 vendor slots plus public circulation; active capacity depends on assigned merchants, stock, schedule and accessible storage.

jobs.description: guard and hauler during market periods

construction.description: 3 stages: public-space preparation; stall frames and counters; permissions and market activation. Individual stalls can be added modularly.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when local surplus, shortages, population or visitor demand justify trade. Empty stalls provide no stock; theft, weather, blocked routes or no vendors reduce service.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Village centre, square or festival ground with foot traffic and no blocked road access.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Covered market hall, specialised market district, auction square or culture-specific bazaar.
definitions.culture_and_style: Open weekly market, covered bazaar, floating stalls, underground trade court, fae barter circle or caravan pop-up market.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Vendor capacity comes from reachable marked stalls and real stock access. Decorative kiosks cannot create merchants or goods.

definitions.purpose: Handles imports, exports, contracts, caravan loading and reputation-based regional trade between the settlement and outside partners.

capacity.description: Draft one trade counter, contract board, secure stock room and loading bay; route slots determine simultaneous trade links.

construction.description: 6 stages: foundation; shell; counter and office; secure store; loading bay; ledger and route activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when a viable route, surplus, shortage or diplomatic opportunity exists. Pauses when routes are unsafe, stock unavailable, permissions revoked or storage blocked.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Settlement edge or main road with strong warehouse access, turning and loading space and controlled public entry.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Covered market, caravanserai, merchant exchange, customs facility through 20C or 20D, or portal trade station through 20E.
definitions.culture_and_style: Frontier post, caravan lodge, river trade house, subterranean trade gate, fae exchange grove or dimensional embassy market.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must connect to a real road or route and physical stock. Player designs cannot create off-map trade without an approved route profile and ownership controls.

definitions.purpose: Provides dense permanent commerce, specialist vendors, protected public circulation and market administration at town scale.

capacity.description: Multiple permanent and rotating vendor bays, central storage links and large visitor throughput; exact capacity comes from validated stalls and routes.

construction.description: 7-9 stages; the public shell and some stalls can open before full specialist wings.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when stall congestion, trade volume and town population justify a permanent hall. Service degrades with empty vendors, poor logistics, crime, sanitation or blocked access.
planner.placement_and_utilities: High-centrality town parcel or market district with road, transit, warehouse and emergency access.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Grand market, trade district, auction house, regional exchange or culture-specific bazaar complex through 20F or 20G.
definitions.culture_and_style: Timber market hall, stone bazaar, canal market, underground trade cavern, living canopy market or portal-linked exchange.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must meet crowd-flow, loading, vendor and storage requirements. Empty decorative arcades do not provide market capacity.

definitions.purpose: Supports long-distance caravans, coaches or pack animals through secure lodging, yards, storage, repairs and route information.

capacity.description: One or more caravan groups based on yard, guest beds, animal stalls and loading bays; not required for settlements without overland trade.

construction.description: 8-10 stages often split into yard and gate, stable, inn, storage and repair subprojects.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Eligible only on active caravan or coach routes. Demand falls if routes shift; raids, disease, feed shortages or no secure storage reduce use.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Town edge or major junction with turning space, warehouse access, water and security.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Regional caravan hub, freight depot through 20D, merchant enclave or portal logistics centre through 20E.
definitions.culture_and_style: Walled desert caravanserai, forest coaching inn, mountain mule lodge, river barge rest, air-caravan dock or realm-traveller court.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must prove large-vehicle or animal access, guest and cargo separation, secure circulation and route connection.

definitions.purpose: Coordinates regional contracts, merchant membership, trade information, finance, dispute handling and large-volume exchange.

capacity.description: City-level clerks, meeting rooms, contract desks and secure records; affects the number and quality of trade contracts rather than directly producing goods.

inputs.description: secure communications and member stock guarantees

construction.description: 8-10 stages with secure records and authority commissioning before advanced contracts unlock.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when city trade volume, routes and merchant population justify coordination. Corruption, insolvency, war or broken communications can reduce trust and contract access.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Central commercial district near market, bank or treasury, administration and regional transport.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Grand exchange, national trade ministry, interrealm commerce council or culture and faction merchant palace through 20F or 20G.
definitions.culture_and_style: Guild exchange, counting house, clan merchant council, floating auction hall, subterranean gem exchange or portal trade senate.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must include secure records and contract service; decorative grand halls do not generate finance or regional trade capacity.

definitions.purpose: Provides basic literacy, numeracy, settlement knowledge and supervised learning for children or adults without creating a separate Education need bar.

capacity.description: Draft one teacher and 6-20 learners based on classroom markers; attendance uses schedules and household or work rules.

inputs.description: maintenance and curriculum or knowledge access

construction.description: 5 stages: foundation; shell; classroom; teaching and storage furnishings; staffing and curriculum activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when population, children, literacy needs, specialist succession or culture priorities justify it. No teacher or materials means no active service, though the room can host community lessons.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Accessible residential or civic area with safe routes and manageable noise.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Trade school, library or archive, academy campus through 20F or culture-specific learning house.
definitions.culture_and_style: One-room school, clan teaching hall, monastery class, apprenticeship courtyard, oral-tradition fire circle or rune-learning chamber.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Capacity comes from reachable teaching and learner markers. Player designs may be a schoolhouse, tutor lodge or outdoor learning grove if the profile is satisfied.

definitions.purpose: Trains apprentices and converts experienced workers into a sustainable specialist pipeline for settlement jobs.

capacity.description: One or more training bays and draft 4-16 learners; capacity and available courses depend on instructors, linked workshops, tools and curriculum.

outputs.description: reduced hiring dependency and unlocked vocational recipes

construction.description: 6-8 stages; classroom service may activate before all specialist training bays.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when missing specialists, an aging workforce, unemployment or growth creates succession demand. Training slows without masters, tools, practice stock or linked jobs.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near the artisan district and participating workshops with safe learner routes.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Guild academy, engineering school, military school through 20C, magical academy through 20E or 20F, or university through 20F.
definitions.culture_and_style: Apprentice guild, master-and-student yard, clan craft school, mobile caravan school, memory-teaching hall or golem-assisted training lab.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must specify supported training profiles and safe learner workstations; seating alone does not generate skilled workers.

definitions.purpose: Stores books, maps, records, recipes, settlement history and research references as physical knowledge rather than a passive global unlock list.

capacity.description: Collection capacity, reading or research seats and secure archive sections; service depends on staff, preserved records, access and relevant knowledge items.

jobs.description: cartographer and guard for restricted collections

inputs.description: climate or fire protection and cataloguing labour

construction.description: 7-9 stages; public reading service can open before the secure archive or specialist wings.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when knowledge stock, research, literacy and town governance justify it. Fire, moisture, theft, corruption or absent staff can damage access and collections.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Civic or education district with a safe, dry, low-risk environment and strong fire or security protection.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Grand library, university library, restricted archive, magical memory hall through 20E or capital knowledge complex through 20F.
definitions.culture_and_style: Scriptorium, oral-history hall, crystal memory archive, living library, stone rune archive, dream library or subterranean map vault.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must store actual knowledge records or items and provide controlled access; decorative shelves alone do not unlock recipes.

definitions.purpose: Provides advanced teaching, specialist succession, research, archives and professional coordination across several faculties without making education a separate settlement need.

capacity.description: Draft student places, faculty positions, research slots and knowledge output depend on validated teaching/research markers, staff, books/data, tools, utilities, safety and available specialist pathways.

inputs.description: power/mana where relevant and funding or patronage according to governance

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when the city has stable basic needs, enough students and specialists, research demand and sustained resources. It can fail through faculty loss, archive damage, political restriction, unsafe research or insufficient utilities.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Accessible from housing and civic routes, protected from industrial hazards and able to expand by faculty. Some cultures may place it inside a temple, palace, guild quarter, cave, forest or floating district.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Grand University, Guild University, Arcane University, Military Academy Campus, Agricultural College, Dimensional Institute or distributed collegiate system.
definitions.culture_and_style: Stone collegiate court, tower academy, guild campus, monastery university, forest memory grove, dwarven archive-forge, desert observatory college or floating magitech institute.

definitions.purpose: Organises a recognised profession through contracts, training, standards, membership, representation and specialist identity.

capacity.description: One profession or compatible group profile with meeting, office, training and contract capacity; it coordinates rather than replaces actual workplaces.

inputs.description: meeting supplies and linked profession data

outputs.description: reputation and culture or faction identity

construction.description: 6-8 stages; a basic contract office can activate before the ceremonial hall or expanded training rooms.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when enough workers and contracts exist to justify organisation. Empty membership or no linked profession provides little benefit; political conflict can split or suppress guilds.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near the relevant district or civic centre with access to member workplaces and market or governance routes.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Grand guild, professional college, faction order, regional standards office or specialist headquarters through 20F or 20G.
definitions.culture_and_style: Craft guild hall, clan lodge, merchant fraternity, ranger lodge, mage order, underground union hall or floating professional conclave.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must select a recognised profession profile and connect to real workers or workplaces; a generic meeting room cannot grant all guild benefits at once.

definitions.purpose: Provides the first dedicated civic centre for requests, permissions, leadership, public records, settlement decisions and stage administration.

capacity.description: Draft one active leader or council profile, one clerk position, a public request and service counter, and an assembly area sized for a small village. Capacity is based on valid offices and public access, not decorative floor area.

inputs.description: maintenance supplies and optional treasury or notice-board stock

construction.description: 6 stages: site and foundation; civic shell; roof and entrances; desks and records; public board and assembly space; inspection and activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required for normal Village-stage administration unless a validated culture-specific equivalent exists. Pauses services if no recognised leader or clerk, public access is blocked, records are destroyed or ownership is disputed.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Central or easily reached civic parcel with safe public access. It may connect to a square, market or blueprint office but must not require a fortification to function.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Town Hall or Council House; attached Records and Planning Office; attached Blueprint and Construction Office; culture-specific council, moot or clan-hall branch.
definitions.culture_and_style: Elder lodge, roundhouse moot, open council pavilion, dwarven clan chamber, fae grove council, nomad banner court or arcane civic hall.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must separate public and secure work areas, provide a valid request/permission interface, council or leader station, records and safe crowd access. A decorative grand hall cannot claim governance capacity without these markers.

definitions.purpose: Coordinates multiple districts, laws, budgets, public services and larger project queues once village-scale administration is no longer sufficient.

capacity.description: Draft several council or office positions, public service counters, a formal assembly chamber and town-level planning capacity. Exact staff and room counts scale through blueprint profiles.

inputs.description: lighting and service information from districts

outputs.description: elections or succession events where the governance profile supports them

construction.description: 8 stages, with public service and clerk functions activating before final ceremonial rooms or prestige decoration.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Triggered when population, district count, project volume, laws or public services exceed Village Hall capacity. Underperforms when offices are vacant, records fragmented, treasury inaccessible or districts disconnected.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Prominent and accessible civic centre connected to major roads and district services; should have emergency access and secure service circulation.

definitions.upgrade_notes: City Hall or Civic Complex owned by 20F; attached court, records office, customs office, embassy wing or prestige civic square.
definitions.culture_and_style: Republican council house, royal borough hall, clan senate, merchant council, temple-governed court, arcane administration tower or underground assembly vault.
