definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must expose multiple service functions, accessible public circulation, secure records and valid council or authority stations. Oversized ceremonial space alone does not increase administrative capacity.

definitions.purpose: Coordinates city districts, laws, records, planning, public services, budgets, disputes, permits and regional administration through a physical civic centre rather than an abstract menu bonus.

capacity.description: Draft administrative case load, district coordination and project approval capacity depends on offices, records, staff, communications, public access, security and utility reliability.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when district count, population, service complexity and regional authority exceed the Town Hall. It becomes strained when staff, records, communications, public access or political legitimacy fail.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Prominent, accessible and defensible civic parcel connected to public transport, market, records and emergency routes. It should not be the only route through the city or an unavoidable military choke point.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Capital Council Complex, Distributed Borough Administration, Palace/High Council Complex, Civic Castle, Grand Court or culture-specific assembly precinct.
definitions.culture_and_style: Republican forum, clan moot complex, merchant council hall, dwarven thane court, fae seasonal assembly, temple-government precinct, bureaucratic tower or distributed neighbourhood halls.

definitions.purpose: Maintains maps, census records, parcels, roads, project schedules and development history so expansion remains legible and save-safe.

capacity.description: Draft several clerk, survey and planning desks; supports a bounded number of active parcels, districts and project records according to blueprint and staffing profile.

outputs.description: heritage records and reduced planning conflicts

construction.description: 6 stages: protected shell; archive fittings; map/planning area; public counter; secure records; inspection and catalogue activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when parcel conflicts, project backlog, district complexity, census uncertainty or blueprint volume causes Infrastructure strain. Fails when records burn, staff are absent, ownership data conflicts or archive capacity is exceeded.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near Town Hall, Blueprint Office or a civic square; protected from fire, flood and uncontrolled public access.

definitions.upgrade_notes: City planning bureau, national archive or integrated civic complex through 20F; may absorb the Blueprint Office at higher stages.
definitions.culture_and_style: Wax-tablet archive, rune-record vault, oral-history chamber with scribes, living-tree memory hall, crystal map room or mechanical survey office.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must provide secure dry storage, working map and planning positions, controlled public access and a clear record workflow. Empty bookshelves do not create planning capacity.

definitions.purpose: Provides a visible process for disputes, reported crimes, evidence, hearings, fines, warrants and limited temporary detention without making guards omniscient.

capacity.description: Draft one hearing room, one magistrate or justice station, clerk and witness capacity, evidence storage and a small holding profile where laws permit.

inputs.description: guard support and basic detainee provisions where holding is used

outputs.description: reputation effects and lawful escalation to exile

construction.description: 7 stages including secure shell, public hearing area, records, evidence storage, guard access, optional holding and legal commissioning.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Conditional on crime/dispute volume, formal laws, population and faction expectations. Does not operate without a recognised authority, law profile, staff, reports or valid evidence/witness process.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Accessible civic area with secure connection to guard routes; should not expose detainees or evidence to public traffic.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Higher court, appeals chamber, prison or justice complex only if later mechanics justify separate universal definitions; can attach to Town Hall or Fort.
definitions.culture_and_style: Magistrate house, clan arbitration circle, oath court, merchant tribunal, spirit-witness shrine, dwarven law vault or mobile nomad judgment pavilion.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must separate public, judicial, evidence and holding circulation; provide safe exits and humane detention where used. A throne room or prison cell alone cannot claim justice service.

definitions.purpose: Manages tolls, tariffs, tribute, declared goods, inspections and route permissions where the settlement law or political situation requires them.

capacity.description: Draft one or more inspection lanes or counters, a small secure treasury or evidence store and staff capacity matched to the connected gate, port or caravan route.

outputs.description: trade statistics and political or reputation consequences

construction.description: 5-6 stages, with inspection and ledger functions activating before prestige frontage or expanded storage.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Triggered by route value, taxation law, faction border, smuggling pressure, conquest or trade volume. Fails without authority, staff, route traffic, secure storage or clear tariff rules.
planner.placement_and_utilities: At or near a gate, port, bridge, market route or customs boundary. Must preserve traffic flow and emergency access.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Customs house, treasury complex, border administration or integrated trade exchange; occupation or tribute variant uses the same function with different laws and consequences.
definitions.culture_and_style: Gate tax booth, harbour customs hall, merchant weigh house, tribute lodge, rune-seal checkpoint or caravan counting tent.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must connect to a real route and provide safe inspection, queue and secure storage zones. Decorative toll booths cannot collect from unrelated distant trade.

definitions.purpose: Supports resident or visiting envoys, formal negotiation, treaties, cultural exchange and secure faction contact.

capacity.description: Draft one or more delegations, negotiation rooms, secure document storage and optional guest accommodation depending on the blueprint profile.

outputs.description: warnings and diplomatic incidents remembered by the world

construction.description: 8 stages; reception and negotiation can activate before full guest wing, gardens or prestige decoration.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Conditional on sustained faction contact, treaties, visitors, regional importance or conflict mediation. Underperforms without envoys, interpreters, security, hospitality or recognised diplomatic status.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Civic or diplomatic district with safe road, port or portal access; must be defensible without resembling a prison.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Diplomatic quarter, realm embassy, grand treaty hall or palace wing through 20F/20G.
definitions.culture_and_style: Shared neutral hall, foreign enclave, floating embassy, portal embassy, clan guesthouse, merchant legation or warded inter-realm mission.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must separate public reception, secure negotiation, archives and guest circulation. A decorative foreign-style building cannot claim diplomatic capacity without active faction links and staff.

definitions.purpose: Provides an official residence, reception space and visible authority symbol for a leader whose role has outgrown ordinary housing.

capacity.description: Draft one leader household, official office and reception profile, staff and guard points; prestige capacity depends on culture and events rather than raw luxury blocks.

inputs.description: ceremonial or cultural goods and hospitality stock

outputs.description: emergency-command fallback and high-value political events

construction.description: 8 stages, with residence and office activating before ceremonial halls, gardens or prestige elements.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when governance profile, population, diplomacy or culture expects an official residence. Becomes a raid, coup or protest target if security, legitimacy or public access is poorly managed.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Protected civic parcel with controlled public access. It may adjoin Town Hall but should not block normal services or become the only command point.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Palace or High Council Complex owned by 20F; branch into modest civic residence, fortified keep residence or culture-specific leadership compound.
definitions.culture_and_style: Mayor house, clan chief compound, elected speaker residence, royal governor manor, fae seasonal court, dwarven thane hall or mage-governor tower.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must clearly separate private, official, public and guard circulation. Decorative luxury does not create authority; an active recognised leader and governance profile are required.

definitions.purpose: Provides culture-defining capital leadership, diplomacy, ceremonial authority, strategic coordination and secure continuity of government. It supports monarchy, council, senate, clan, theocracy or other governance forms rather than assuming a single palace model.

capacity.description: Draft diplomatic, governance, ceremonial and crisis-command capacity depends on valid chambers, staff, records, security, communications, utilities, public legitimacy and protected continuity spaces.

outputs.description: story access and regional crisis coordination

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected after capital status, stable governance, diplomacy and major supply chains. Failure can involve legitimacy crisis, occupation, archive loss, faction conflict, siege or incomplete ceremonial commitments.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Capital landmark with controlled public access, secure logistics, multiple evacuation routes and separation between ceremonial, residential, administrative and strategic zones. It may integrate a citadel without becoming inaccessible to citizens.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Grand Palace, High Senate, Sacred Council Precinct, Floating Palace, Realm Embassy Court or World Council Complex.
definitions.culture_and_style: Royal palace, senate forum, clan ring-fort, dwarven high hall, fae seasonal court, merchant conclave, mage council citadel, floating celestial court or underground ancestral complex.

definitions.purpose: Connects player and NPC blueprint creation to settlement permissions, parcel assignment, cost estimates, construction queues and project history.

capacity.description: Draft several blueprint review, planning and survey positions and a bounded queue of proposed or active player/NPC projects.

jobs.description: player proposer and visiting household or guild representative

outputs.description: approved project records and builder task packages

construction.description: 6 stages: office shell; drafting area; records; public submission; project board and survey gear; validation commissioning.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when player blueprints, project count, parcel conflicts or construction backlog become meaningful. Pauses approvals if no planner, records, map data, permissions or validated submission interface.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near Village Hall, Records Office, Builder Supply Yard or warehouse access; requires enough public space to inspect designs without blocking builders.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Integrated planning bureau, civic blueprint library, district design office or automated/magical modelling branch through 20E/20F.
definitions.culture_and_style: Architect guild lodge, builder moot, rune-model chamber, holographic map room, clay model court, dwarven survey vault or nomad route-planning tent.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must support submission, preview/review, approval record, parcel link and project output. Decorative drawing tables do not grant settlement-wide blueprint authority.

definitions.purpose: Provides local patrol assignment, guard readiness, equipment access and rapid response coverage for a village area or route.

capacity.description: Draft one to four active guards depending on valid stations, equipment and patrol network; extra decorative beds or chairs do not increase response capacity.

outputs.description: gate support and visible security presence

construction.description: 5 stages: foundation; shell; guard station; equipment and signal; patrol-link inspection and activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required at Village stage where threat settings are active. Fails with no guards, equipment, safe route, authority or patrol links; overloaded coverage creates slow response rather than invisible protection.
planner.placement_and_utilities: At a village centre, gate, market, road junction or vulnerable facility. Coverage should overlap meaningfully rather than encouraging unlimited post spam.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Expanded watch house, barracks, gatehouse post, mounted patrol station or culture-specific guard lodge.
definitions.culture_and_style: Town watch booth, clan warrior lodge, ranger post, fae sentinel tree, dwarven gate alcove, nomad mounted post or magical scry-watch room.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must provide guard work positions, secure equipment, path sockets and a reachable response route. A decorative hut cannot claim patrol coverage.

definitions.purpose: Provides elevated detection, warning, ranged defence and the core proof that preparation changes a raid outcome.

capacity.description: Draft one to three guards, a defined sight and signal profile and limited ammunition or emergency supply storage.

inputs.description: maintenance materials and accessible patrol support

outputs.description: signal events and reduced surprise during raids

construction.description: 7 stages: site; foundation; frame; upper platform; safe access; railing/cover and signal; inspection. Functional warning may activate before final decoration.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required in the POC defence loop and selected when scouting, raids or blind approaches create Safety pressure. Fails if sightlines are blocked, access is unsafe, no guard or signal exists, or damage disables the platform.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Perimeter, ridge or strategic approach with real line-of-sight and safe access. Overlapping towers give diminishing returns unless they cover distinct approaches.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Stone watchtower, gatehouse tower, beacon chain, ward tower or integrated city wall tower.
definitions.culture_and_style: Timber tower, treetop lookout, desert beacon, cliff perch, dwarven shaft tower, nomad signal mast or rune-lit sentinel platform.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must meet minimum height/coverage profile, safe climb, usable deck, signal marker and sightline checks. A tall decorative spire cannot grant detection without guard access and observation points.

definitions.purpose: Creates a modular early perimeter that delays, channels and reveals attackers without pretending to make a settlement invulnerable.

capacity.description: Coverage is calculated from connected segment length, height, collision, terrain fit, gates and breach state rather than a single building capacity.

outputs.description: livestock or civilian separation and visible breach points

construction.description: 4 stages per module: layout posts; structural barrier; bracing and connections; inspection/repair points. Large perimeters build by segments rather than one huge timer.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required in the POC only where the village defence plan calls for a perimeter; otherwise equivalent terrain or cultural defences may validate. Fails through gaps, low terrain clearance, disconnected gates, fire damage or blocked evacuation.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Along an approved perimeter plan that respects roads, water, terrain, future expansion and emergency exits. It should not trap residents or block essential work routes.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Reinforced timber wall, stone wall and gatehouse system, ditch or earthwork attachment, warded palisade or culture-specific living barrier.
definitions.culture_and_style: Sharpened logs, woven thorn wall, earthen rampart, giant bone fence, living hedge, rune stakes, ice barrier or portable wagon laager.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Player modules must connect cleanly, provide real collision/delay, expose breach and repair states and preserve valid paths. Decorative fences cannot claim palisade defence.

definitions.purpose: Creates a controlled road opening, guard point and defensible connection through an early perimeter.

capacity.description: Draft one main road opening, one or more guard stations and a permission/lock profile. Throughput depends on clear width, mechanism, staffing and traffic.

jobs.description: patrols and builders or repair workers

outputs.description: curfew or permission enforcement and incident reporting

construction.description: 6 stages: foundations/posts; frame; gate leaves or barrier; mechanism; guard/signal positions; road and perimeter inspection.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required with the POC palisade. Fails if no perimeter connection, road is blocked, mechanism cannot operate, guards cannot reach positions or permissions lock residents inside.
planner.placement_and_utilities: At a connected palisade or equivalent boundary on a real road. Must allow daily traffic, carts where intended and emergency evacuation.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Stone gatehouse, customs gate, portcullis system, warded gate or ceremonial city entrance.
definitions.culture_and_style: Timber gate, wagon gate, thorn arch, dwarven stone door, desert portcullis, fae living arch or rune-sealed threshold.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must preserve road clearance, actual open/closed states, guard access, perimeter sockets and emergency operation. Decorative archways do not provide access control.

definitions.purpose: Houses or musters guards, trains replacements and improves readiness for settlements facing repeated threats.

capacity.description: Draft six to twenty-four guard or militia places and several training stations, scaled by valid beds, muster space, instructors, gear and logistics.

jobs.description: cook or stable worker where extensions exist

outputs.description: improved skill/readiness and organised patrol shifts

construction.description: 7-8 stages, allowing muster and training functions to activate before full dormitory or prestige completion.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected after repeated raids, guard shortages, population growth or military policy. Underperforms without captain/trainer, gear, valid training space, provisions or patrol connections.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Inside a defended district with clear training space and rapid routes to gates, towers and vulnerable areas; noise and weapon clearances must be respected.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Military academy, cavalry barracks, fort complex, city guard headquarters or culture-specific warrior hall.
definitions.culture_and_style: Militia hall, warrior longhouse, ranger compound, knight barracks, dwarven shield hall, nomad mounted camp or battle-mage training court.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must expose real safe training zones, muster capacity, equipment and duty accommodation. Decorative targets and beds alone do not increase readiness.

definitions.purpose: Replaces or reinforces early barriers with durable connected walls, towers, patrol routes and controlled gates suited to siege and town-scale defence.

capacity.description: Coverage derives from connected wall modules, parapet access, towers, gates, foundations, terrain, damage and staffed patrol sectors.

outputs.description: civilian confidence and visible breach/repair state

construction.description: 8-stage modular profile: survey; foundations; lower wall; full wall; parapet/access; towers/gatehouse; mechanisms; inspection. Segments can activate independently.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Triggered by Fortified Village growth, strategic wealth, repeated siege threats or political borders. Fails through disconnected sectors, inaccessible patrols, unstable foundations, blocked gates or insufficient maintenance.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Town perimeter plan respecting terrain, roads, rivers, expansion zones, utilities and evacuation. Walls should exploit geography rather than require a perfect circle.

definitions.upgrade_notes: City wall complex, layered fortress, warded wall, anti-siege additions, moat/earthworks or realm-specific defensive boundary.
definitions.culture_and_style: Ashlar curtain wall, dwarven mountain rampart, desert bastion, living-root wall, ice fortress, giant masonry, arcane barrier pylons or terraced cliff defence.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Modules must form a coherent network with real collision, access, height and repair states. Inaccessible decorative battlements cannot provide patrol or ranged capacity.

definitions.purpose: Stores, maintains, issues and accounts for guard weapons, armour, ammunition and emergency equipment.

capacity.description: Draft equipment sets and secure storage slots based on real racks, containers, quartermaster stations, item condition and permissions.

outputs.description: equipment condition tracking and reduced loss or theft

construction.description: 6 stages: secure shell; reinforced doors; racks/stores; maintenance/issue point; inventory records; inspection and activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when guards exist but equipment readiness is low, stock is dispersed or raids justify reserves. Fails without quartermaster permissions, real stock, secure access, safe storage or repair support.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near barracks, gatehouse, fort or guard headquarters; protected from fire, theft, flooding and uncontrolled public access.

definitions.upgrade_notes: City arsenal, siege store, magical armoury, faction vault or integrated fort supply complex.
definitions.culture_and_style: Shield hall, weapon vault, ranger cache, dwarven arsenal, nomad wagon armoury, rune-locked store or living-wood bow house.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Capacity must map to real secured storage and item types. Decorative weapon displays do not count as available guard equipment.

definitions.purpose: Provides a durable command, refuge, reserve and defensive strongpoint for a town or strategic route. It does not automatically create a complete perimeter or replace guards, roads, supply and civilian evacuation.

capacity.description: Draft garrison, refuge, command, reserve and defence capacity is derived from validated rooms, staff, weapons, stores, water, routes, sightlines, condition and integration with the wider defence plan.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when threat, border, route, wealth or political control justifies it. It is costly and can increase raid value, fear, occupation pressure or maintenance burden.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Strategic high ground, route crossing, border, harbour or town edge with access to settlement logistics. It must not trap civilians or block all normal trade and emergency movement.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Citadel and Fortified Perimeter Complex, Border Fortress, Harbour Fort, Mountain Fortress, Civic Castle or warded magical bastion.
definitions.culture_and_style: Timber hill fort, stone keep, dwarven gate-fort, desert kasbah, forest ring-fort, cliff fortress, harbour castle, floating guard platform or rune-bastion.

definitions.purpose: Provides trained response, equipment and dispatch for fires, collapses, floods, accidents and non-military rescue events.

capacity.description: Draft one or more response teams, equipment bays and service coverage based on staffing, water/tools, roads and travel time.

construction.description: 6-7 stages, with equipment bay and dispatch activating before full crew quarters or training extensions.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when density, flammable materials, industry, disasters or incident travel time create Safety pressure. Fails without trained crew, water, tools, alarm, route access or maintained equipment.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Central to dense or high-risk districts with reliable water and unobstructed emergency routes; should not be isolated behind market queues or closed gates.

definitions.upgrade_notes: City emergency headquarters, harbour rescue, mine rescue, magical disaster response or integrated hospital/emergency complex.
definitions.culture_and_style: Bucket brigade hall, water-cart house, dwarven mine rescue station, desert cistern brigade, fae growth-healing response or rune-powered fire ward depot.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must support rapid exit, equipment loading, water access and safe return/maintenance. Decorative bell towers do not create rescue service.

definitions.purpose: Protects civilians during raids, storms, fires, magical disasters or other temporary emergencies without replacing permanent housing.

capacity.description: Draft twenty to one hundred or more emergency occupants according to protected volume, exits, air, water, sanitation, provisions and supervision profiles.

inputs.description: fuel or mana where required and maintenance

construction.description: 7-9 stages depending on earthworks or wards: survey; excavation/foundation; protected shell; exits; ventilation/utilities; stores; treatment/muster; inspection and stocking.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Triggered by siege risk, storms, floods, magical instability, population density or prior casualties. Fails if the hazard profile is wrong, exits block, supplies expire, ventilation fails or capacity is falsely claimed.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Outside the most likely hazard footprint or engineered against it, reachable from populated districts by more than one route and not dependent on the failed utility it protects against.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Siege refuge, storm shelter, flood refuge, warded corruption bunker, mountain sanctuary or district shelter network.
definitions.culture_and_style: Cellar refuge, hill fort shelter, cavern sanctuary, raised flood refuge, living-tree cocoon, rune ward vault, mobile evacuation caravan or underground district bunker.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must prove protected capacity, evacuation routes, exits, utilities and stock positions under the intended hazard profile. A deep decorative room cannot count as a bunker by depth alone.

definitions.purpose: Provides protected shared storage for food, tools, fuel, construction stock and household overflow before the settlement can support a full warehouse.

capacity.description: Draft several category zones or containers; exact capacity derives from valid storage markers, containers and access rather than building footprint.

construction.description: 5 stages: foundation; shell; roof/door; containers and category zones; ledger, inspection and activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Triggered by scattered stock, spoilage, theft, project delay or household overflow. Underperforms when full, wet, damaged, unlabelled, inaccessible or permissions block intended users.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Central and dry, connected to homes, food and project routes; avoid floodplain, fire source and animal contamination.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Village Warehouse, Granary, Tool Depot, Fuel Store, Guard Store or culture-specific communal cache.
definitions.culture_and_style: Raised timber store, underground cool cellar, communal longhouse store, clay granary room, stone vault or living-tree hollow.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must contain reachable valid storage markers, dry protected interior, public/shared access, category compatibility and loading space. Empty decorative shelving does not count.

definitions.purpose: Becomes the authoritative village inventory hub for category storage, project reservations, deliveries, donations, contracts, emergency reserves and automation permissions.

capacity.description: Draft multiple storage zones, secure reserve capacity, loading service and ledger throughput. Exact values derive from containers, zones, condition, staffing, access and permissions.

inputs.description: repair materials and optional security equipment

outputs.description: category alerts and trusted automation input/output

construction.description: 7 stages: site/foundation; structural shell; weatherproofing; storage zones; loading and staff areas; ledger/reserve/security; inspection and activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required for normal Village project reservation. Fails or degrades when full, understaffed, looted, burned, permissions conflict, loading is blocked, categories are contaminated or save ledger state is invalid.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Connected to main road, market, production and construction routes; enough loading clearance; protected from flood, fire and direct raid approach where practical.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Construction Warehouse, Food Warehouse, Trade Warehouse, Armoury link, Automated Distribution Centre, Magical Vault or district warehouse.
definitions.culture_and_style: Timber hall, fortified stone depot, canal warehouse, subterranean vault, merchant courtyard, fae root-cellar network or arcane indexed store.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must separate public, secure, project and loading functions; expose category zones, valid routes and ledger/control markers; automation ports cannot bypass ownership.

definitions.purpose: Stores one or a small set of resource categories more safely or efficiently than a general warehouse, reducing congestion and supporting industry, food reserves or emergency stock.

capacity.description: Draft high category-specific capacity with storage-quality modifiers such as dry, cool, sealed, ventilated, secure or hazardous.

inputs.description: pest control and optional power/temperature inputs

outputs.description: safer hazard separation and reduced warehouse pressure

construction.description: 5-7 stages depending on branch, including foundation, shell/tank/silo, category fittings, loading, safety and activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when one category repeatedly fills general storage, spoils, creates danger or limits production. Fails when wrong stock is inserted, safety separation is invalid or maintenance is ignored.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near its production/consumer chain but separated from incompatible hazards. Food silos avoid contamination; fuel depots avoid homes and fire sources.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Granary, Timber Yard, Stone Yard, Fuel Depot, Cold Store, Hazard Store, Guard Supply Depot or district bulk depot.
definitions.culture_and_style: Grain tower, underground ice cellar, open timber seasoning yard, clay amphora store, stone fuel bunker, rune-sealed vault or giant seed pod.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must declare accepted categories and prove appropriate environment, loading, containment and access. General empty volume does not earn specialised capacity.

definitions.purpose: Coordinates high-volume storage, sorting, district replenishment and automated or vehicle-based freight once manual warehouse labour becomes a city-scale bottleneck.

capacity.description: Draft high storage and transfer capacity split across buffers, sorting lanes, dispatch points and network interfaces; actual throughput is bounded by power, ports, routes and destinations.

construction.description: 8-10 stages with manual storage activating before full sorting, powered dispatch and advanced network links.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when city warehouses are full, hauling labour is excessive, districts starve despite surplus or trade throughput is blocked. Pauses safely on power or output failure by default.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Industrial or logistics district with heavy-road, rail, belt, water or portal-compatible corridors. It must not route dangerous freight through dense housing without safeguards.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Regional Logistics Hub, Portal Freight Nexus or culture-specific magitech distribution complex through 20E/20F.
definitions.culture_and_style: Mechanical sorting hall, canal exchange warehouse, dwarven rail depot, golem-dispatch court, rune-indexed vault or portal distribution chamber.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must prove directional flow, buffers, maintenance access, staff safety, ownership, emergency shutdown and compatible network ports. Decorative conveyors do not create throughput.

definitions.display_name: Dirt Path and Road Junction Set
definitions.purpose: Provides the first formal route graph connecting settlement centre, homes, farms, stores, workplaces, hall, defences and future parcels.

capacity.description: Foot and light service access; selected segments may support handcarts depending on width, slope and weather. Capacity derives from connected valid nodes, not total path blocks.

outputs.description: patrol connection and visible settlement organisation

construction.description: 2 stages per segment: survey/clear; surface/edge and connect. Junctions or culverts may add stages.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required for the POC access graph. New paths are selected when key entrances are disconnected or travel cost is excessive. Mud, flood, obstruction and unsafe slope reduce service.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Adapt to terrain and existing desire paths; avoid blocking water flow, entrances, expansion parcels, farms and protected sites.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Gravel path, Stone Road and Bridge Set, street, service lane, patrol path, boardwalk or culture-specific route.
definitions.culture_and_style: Forest track, packed-earth lane, gravel terrace, plank boardwalk, root path, carved tunnel path or nomad marker trail.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must connect real route nodes and preserve passable clearance. Decorative stripes that do not create valid navigation provide no route service.

definitions.purpose: Upgrades key routes and crossings for carts, weather reliability, evacuation, trade, patrols and heavier settlement growth.

capacity.description: Draft cart and medium freight access with higher weather resistance and crossing load. Exact service depends on width, slope, supports, drainage and connected destinations.

outputs.description: safer public streets and lower haul labour

construction.description: Segment-based 3-6 stages: survey; foundation; supports/drainage; surface; safety/edges; inspection.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when dirt routes fail under weather/load, carts are blocked or critical crossings create risk. Damage, flooding, collapsed supports or blocked gates break continuity.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Prioritise main routes, gates, warehouse, market, clinic, production and bridge chokepoints. Avoid paving every low-use path without demand.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Paved city street, heavy freight road, causeway, drawbridge, aqueduct bridge, tunnel road or monumental avenue.
definitions.culture_and_style: Cobble road, fitted dwarfstone, brick avenue, raised desert causeway, living-root bridge, ice-resistant road or rune-stabilised crossing.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must prove connected route class, vehicle clearance, support/load, safe landings and drainage where required. Visual stone surfacing alone does not grant heavy capacity.

definitions.purpose: Connects the settlement to fishing, ferries, waterborne trade, exploration and regional freight where suitable navigable water exists.

capacity.description: Draft berth, passenger and freight capacity based on valid docks, water approach, loading points, storage, workers and route safety.

construction.description: 7-9 stages: survey/shore works; piles/foundation; deck/quay; berths; loading; storage/service; safety/lights; inspection.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Conditional on water route value. Selected when water reduces travel or unlocks trade. Fails with blocked approach, unsafe water, damaged berth, no staff, route danger or disconnected road.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Stable shore or river parcel with adequate depth/current and road connection. Flood, ice, monsters, tides or storms may require adaptations.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Fishing Dock, Ferry Landing, Trade Harbour, Shipyard, Harbour Fort, Canal Port or Sky/Portal freight link through later documents.
definitions.culture_and_style: Timber river dock, stone quay, floating village harbour, cavern port, fae lily-pad landing, desert canal station or ice harbour.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must connect navigable water to safe land access and prove berth, loading, rescue and clearance. Decorative piers without route markers provide no harbour service.

definitions.purpose: Provides the first reliable public water access point and proves settlement water capacity without individual thirst micromanagement.

capacity.description: Draft Hamlet-scale daily capacity based on valid source, well/pump marker, condition, quality and reachable access.

outputs.description: limited farming/livestock support and emergency firefighting reserve

construction.description: 4 stages: survey/source confirmation; excavation/lining; draw/pump and cover; drainage, inspection and activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Required at Hamlet unless a valid culture/biome equivalent exists. Fails when dry, contaminated, collapsed, blocked, frozen without adaptation or access is unsafe.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Reachable from homes and kitchen but separated from latrines, waste, livestock runoff, industry and flood contamination.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Covered Well, Pump House, Cistern, Aqueduct connection, magical purification or district water system.
definitions.culture_and_style: Stone well, spring house, communal cistern, snow-melt tank, root-filter pool, cave reservoir or shrine-protected water point.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must bind to a real water source and expose safe access, quality and drainage. Decorative water blocks or an unreachable hole provide no service.

definitions.purpose: Expands water storage, transport, pressure and resilience when a dense settlement, drought, elevation, industry or firefighting demand exceeds local water points.

capacity.description: Draft network capacity bounded by source, intake, pump/lift, storage, distribution and access. Redundancy can preserve partial service during faults.

construction.description: Segment-based 6-10 stages, with source and local storage activating before full distribution.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when wells are strained, drought risk is high, districts lack access, fire reserve is low or production requires water. Weakest-link faults reduce output.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Terrain-dependent. Aqueducts require gradient/support; pumps require power or labour; cisterns require protected storage and distribution access.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Reservoir, water tower, pressure network, irrigation system, industrial water, magical purification or realm-specific water utility.
definitions.culture_and_style: Roman-style aqueduct, qanat, dwarven pressure tunnel, rooftop rain network, living-root waterway, canal system or rune-driven pump.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must prove source, direction/gradient or pump, storage, distribution, overflow, maintenance and contamination separation. Decorative channels provide no network capacity.

definitions.purpose: Manages drainage, refuse, wastewater, manure and by-products once density and industry make informal disposal unsafe or inefficient.

capacity.description: Draft district or town load capacity determined by collection, drainage, treatment/disposal, maintenance, route access and safe separation.

inputs.description: fuel/power where used and repair stock

outputs.description: cleaner streets and safer dense settlement growth

construction.description: 6-10 stages split across collection, drains, treatment/disposal, route connection, safety and activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when density, markets, livestock, rain, disease or industry creates Health/Infrastructure pressure. Fails through blockage, overflow, no collection labour, contamination leak or unsafe disposal.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Downstream/downhill or otherwise safely separated from clean water and housing according to system type; connected to service routes.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Covered sewer, compost works, recycling/salvage facility, industrial treatment, magical cleansing or city sanitation department through 20F.
definitions.culture_and_style: Compost village system, canal drainage, stone sewer, desert dry-latrine network, fungal recycler, golem collection route or purification garden.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must expose a complete safe flow from collection to treatment/disposal, with maintenance and clean-water separation. Hidden holes do not create sanitation capacity.

definitions.purpose: Provides the first practical village magic service: a named mage, basic rune crafting, mana handling, teaching, magical repairs and support for early wards and automation.

capacity.description: Draft one specialist work slot, one teaching/service point, a small protected mana store and limited rune/repair throughput.

inputs.description: repair stock and optional ward/conduit components

outputs.description: research hints and community magical services

construction.description: 6 stages: foundation/shell; roof/door; worktable/storage; mana-safe zone; teaching/service markers; inspection and mage activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Conditional on mage arrival, magical discovery, reputation, culture or player action. It remains dormant without a valid specialist or safe mana stock.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Reachable from warehouse, hall and watchtower while keeping a safe buffer from homes if unstable work is performed. Culture and village law determine public access.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Rune Workshop, Alchemy Laboratory, Ward Hall, Mana Engineering Annex, Magic Academy feeder or culture-specific magical house.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must expose reachable work, teaching and storage markers, real mana inventory, a protected rune zone and explicit risk/permission fields. Decorative books and crystals do not grant service.

definitions.purpose: Processes herbs, monster resources, minerals, essences and mana reagents into medicines, catalysts, preservation agents, utility mixtures and controlled magical compounds.

capacity.description: Draft recipe slots, batch size and failure risk depend on benches, vessels, ventilation, ingredient purity, alchemist skill, heat/mana, storage and safety.

construction.description: 6-8 stages: shell; benches/water; storage; heat/mana; ventilation/safety; specialist activation; optional containment annex.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when a trained alchemist, reagent supply and medicine/magic demand exist. Risky recipes may be restricted by law, reputation or world settings.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near healer or magical services but separated from food and dense housing when hazardous recipes are allowed. Clean water and safe waste handling improve reliability.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Advanced Alchemy Lab, Apothecary Laboratory, Industrial Reagent Works, Cleansing Annex or Forbidden Alchemy Cell.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must separate clean, reagent, hazardous and waste functions; declare recipe risks; provide ventilation/wash access and prevent invalid decorative vessels from creating capacity.

definitions.purpose: Creates local protective, warning, cleansing or deterrent coverage through a physical ward anchor connected to mana, runes, settlement permissions and defence systems.

capacity.description: Draft radius or route coverage depends on anchor quality, rune pattern, mana supply, terrain, obstructions, linked relays, specialist tuning and active threat category.

inputs.description: tuning tools and optional signal or watchtower link

outputs.description: protected routes or structure shielding according to the ward profile

construction.description: 4-6 stages per anchor: foundation; stone/frame; rune installation; mana connection; tuning; activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected after repeated magical/creature threats, corruption exposure or cultural ritual demand. It becomes dormant when mana is empty, runes are damaged or ownership changes.
planner.placement_and_utilities: At gates, watchtowers, roads, shrines, warehouses, farms or district boundaries according to the coverage profile. Overlapping wards can provide redundancy or interference.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Linked Relay, Ward Tower, District Ward, Anti-Corruption Barrier, Portal Ward or City Shield component owned partly by 20F.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must define ward profile, coverage, exclusions, mana cost, relay connection, public/hostile ownership and counterplay. Decorative glowing stones provide no protection.

definitions.purpose: Stores refined mana safely, buffers unstable supply and distributes bounded energy to workshops, wards, furnaces, lights and emergency systems.

capacity.description: Draft storage, charge/discharge and purity limits derive from valid batteries/vessels, containment, conduits, controls, condition and specialist oversight.

jobs.description: inspector and guard for valuable stock

inputs.description: Mana crystals/shards/dust or other accepted fuel

construction.description: 5-7 stages: shell/containment; storage vessels; controls; intake/output; safety; inspection; optional network expansion.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when intermittent mana supply, wards or machines need reliable power. It degrades with impurity, overcharge, damaged containment, theft or incompatible fuels.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near consumers but separated from homes and flammable stock according to storage tier. High-value or unstable stores require security and ward coverage.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Arcane Battery House, District Mana Vault, Leyline Buffer, Portal Reserve or hybrid grid storage.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must count only valid storage units, declare accepted mana types/purity, prove controlled intake/output, containment, shutdown and ownership. Empty crystal decorations do not add capacity.

definitions.purpose: Supports staged communal or specialist rituals affecting weather, protection, cleansing, summoning, research, culture, story events and world-state change.

capacity.description: Draft participant slots, ritual scale, stability and cooldown depend on circle geometry, anchors, mana, catalysts, leader skill, assistants, site conditions and permissions.

jobs.description: musicians or participants according to ritual profile

construction.description: 6-9 stages: site preparation; circle/foundation; anchors; participant/public space; mana/safety; cultural finish; attunement and activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected by culture, story, threat, research or major event. It should not run automatically without a valid ritual project, resources and participants.
planner.placement_and_utilities: May require leyline, shrine, open sky, underground chamber, water, cultural district or safe distance depending on ritual family.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Grand Ritual Hall, Weather Circle, Cleansing Sanctuary, Summoning Hall, Realm Gate Ritual Site or culture-specific ceremonial complex.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must validate geometry/anchors, participant access, mana/catalysts, ritual profile, public safety, failure consequences and forbidden flags.

definitions.purpose: Trains advanced magical specialists, coordinates research, preserves spell knowledge and supports city-scale rune, ward, portal and magitech progression.

capacity.description: Draft teaching, research and specialist slots depend on classrooms/labs, library access, faculty, mana, safety, housing links and research equipment.

construction.description: 9-12 stages, with basic teaching and library functions activating before advanced laboratories and towers.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when city population, specialists, research demand, culture and mana infrastructure support it. It loses output when faculty, archives, mana or safety fail.
planner.placement_and_utilities: City academic or magical district with resilient access, mana supply, fire/ward protection and separation between public teaching and hazardous research.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Grand Academy, School-Specific College, Arcane University, Observatory Annex, Portal Faculty or dimensional institute.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must prove teaching/research capacity, controlled practice areas, library/knowledge storage, staff/student access, mana and emergency separation.

definitions.purpose: Provides magical healing support, corruption cleansing, curse stabilisation and recovery services that complement rather than replace mundane healers and hospitals.

capacity.description: Draft treatment slots, cleansing strength and recovery rate depend on healer/practitioner skill, mana, purity, beds/ritual points, medicine and contamination controls.

construction.description: 6-8 stages: shell/sanctuary; treatment space; mana/cleansing; clean/contaminated separation; staff; activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected after magical injuries, corruption exposure, cultural demand or story events. It cannot solve every illness and may require rare reagents or cooldowns.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near health services and public access but with isolation for corruption or curse cases. Water quality, ward protection and emergency route matter.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Cleansing Hospital Wing, Regional Sanctuary, Anti-Corruption Centre, Spirit Healing House or realm-specific recovery facility.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must separate clean and contaminated flows, expose valid treatment points, declare supported conditions, mana cost, practitioner requirements and failure limits.

definitions.purpose: Maps, measures and stabilises regional mana flows, links high-capacity magical networks and unlocks strategic placement for advanced wards, portals and magitech.

capacity.description: Draft sensing range, relay throughput and stabilisation depend on leyline proximity, instruments, altitude/depth, mana quality, specialist staffing, anchors and network condition.

inputs.description: maintenance parts and regional access rights

outputs.description: regional project unlocks and controlled high-capacity mana transfer

construction.description: 8-11 stages: survey; foundation/tower; instruments; anchor; relay; control/research; safety/stabilisation; attunement.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected after regional mana demand or anomalies justify the cost. It can create political conflict over strategic energy and must not provide infinite free mana.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Requires a valid leyline node, crossing or strong survey location. Terrain, corruption, faction territory and interference determine suitability.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Regional Leyline Relay, City Mana Nexus component, Dimensional Resonance Observatory or Leyline Crown subproject through 20F.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must bind to a real leyline record, declare sensing/relay profiles, prove control, stabilisation, limits, failure states and network ownership.

definitions.purpose: Anchors controlled portal travel and freight through a physical station with power, destination records, permissions, arrival safety, stabilisation and shutdown.

capacity.description: Draft traveller/freight throughput, range and destination count depend on portal frame, anchors, mana, stabilisation, operators, cooldowns, security and destination state.

inputs.description: ward power and optional realm fuel

outputs.description: trade and emergency evacuation according to permissions

construction.description: 9-12 stages, with station shell and logistics usable before the portal frame is attuned and authorised.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected after portal knowledge, destination anchor, city infrastructure, political permission and stable mana exist. It closes on destination danger, instability, attack or insufficient power.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Major transport or magical district with protected approaches, emergency route, freight handling and safe separation from housing. Destination hazards affect station design.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Multi-Destination Station, Portal Freight Hub, Realm Embassy Gate, Capital Nexus component or dimensional logistics complex.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must prove frame/anchor geometry, safe arrival volume, destination binding, mana, cooldown, security, freight ownership, shutdown and failure containment.

definitions.purpose: Studies realm materials, portals, creatures, anomalies and environmental rules while containing hazardous samples and protecting the capital from dimensional breach.

capacity.description: Draft laboratory, sample, chamber and containment capacity depend on specialist staff, ward/power redundancy, isolation cells, realm protections, monitoring and emergency systems.

construction.description: 12+ staged subprojects: perimeter; utilities; labs; cells; wards; decontamination; control; archive; emergency systems; commissioning.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected after stable realm access, repeated anomalies or capital research goals. High maintenance and political risk prevent routine early construction.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Capital or remote strategic complex with strong transport but layered separation from civilians. Realm-specific hazards may require underground, isolated, floating or pocket-space construction.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Realm-Specific Wing, Portal Safety Command, Anti-Breach Bastion, Capital Dimensional Institute or 20F megaproject link.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must prove independent containment, redundant shutdown, safe circulation, hazard profiles, sample ownership, decontamination, emergency response and persistent breach consequences.

definitions.purpose: Introduces manual and simple mechanical power, gears, shafts, chutes and machine maintenance without requiring a full industrial grid.

capacity.description: Draft component and power output depends on workstations, cranks, operator stamina/shift abstraction, gearing, tools and maintenance.

outputs.description: educational demonstrations and early automation components

construction.description: 5-6 stages: shell; benches/storage; crank/shaft; test/safety; specialist activation; optional expansion.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when copper mechanisms are unlocked or hauling/processing bottlenecks appear. It remains useful for cheap, reliable and emergency manual systems.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near carpenter/blacksmith and early production with safe moving-part clearance and route access.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Machine Workshop, Powered Mechanism Hall, Water/Wind connection, Rune-Control Annex or mobile repair shop.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must expose real moving/power markers, safe clearance, parts inventory and bounded output. Decorative gears do not generate power.

definitions.purpose: Provides visible renewable mechanical power from suitable water flow or wind exposure for mills, workshops, pumps and early automation.

capacity.description: Draft power output is bounded by source strength, wheel/turbine area, gearing, weather/season, maintenance, transmission loss and obstruction.

inputs.description: repair parts and optional storage/buffer mechanisms

outputs.description: water pumping or direct machine drive
with variable output and source telemetry

construction.description: 6-8 stages: foundations; source structure/tower; wheel/sails; gearing; transmission; control/safety; commissioning.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when terrain provides a reliable source and machines need sustained power. Output varies with season/weather and pauses on obstruction or structural damage.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Waterwheel requires sufficient flow/drop and bank support; wind power requires exposure and clearance. Both must avoid blocking navigation or protected terrain.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Larger Waterwheel, Windmill Array, Pump House, Mechanical Power Station, Hybrid Mana Assist or district shaft network.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must bind to real water/wind data, prove clearance, direction, power output, brake/shutdown, maintenance and connection. Visual motion without a source produces no power.

definitions.purpose: Processes ore and materials through a shared furnace family, with mundane fuel first and an optional mana branch proving magical infrastructure in the settlement supply chain.

capacity.description: Draft recipe slots, heat, batch size and efficiency depend on furnace modules, fuel/mana, airflow, operator skill, material quality, output buffer and upgrades.

construction.description: 6-8 stages, with basic fuel furnace operational before mana upgrade, improved controls and automation ports.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when ore supply and metal demand justify local processing. It stops on no fuel/power, blocked output, unsafe heat, damaged chamber or unstable mana.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near mine/warehouse and road/logistics, with fire/heat separation. Mana branch requires safe store/conduit and stabilisation.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Improved Furnace, Mana Furnace, Blast Furnace, Foundry Feed Furnace, Arcane Alloy Furnace or culture-specific forge.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must prove input-output conservation, heat/fuel or mana source, ventilation/cooling, waste, operator safety, buffers and deterministic recipes.

definitions.purpose: Uses interchangeable powered modules to crush, saw, mill, press or perform other simple repeatable processing at greater scale than hand stations.

capacity.description: Draft throughput depends on selected module, power, input/output buffers, operator/maintenance, material hardness and machine condition.

construction.description: 6-7 stages: shell/foundation; power train; buffers; module; controls/safety; activation.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when a repeated processing chain creates labour or yield pressure. The planner avoids duplicate mills without distinct demand or module role.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Near relevant raw supply and warehouse with route/power access. Noise/dust or food hygiene determines district placement.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Multi-Module Mill, High-Efficiency Processor, Rune-Control Mill, Industrial Processing Plant or culture-specific machine.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must declare module/recipe family, prove power, buffers, maintenance and by-product handling. One decorative machine cannot process every material.

definitions.purpose: Connects belts, chutes, carts, roads, storage and production through visible transfer points, sorting, buffers and permissions.

capacity.description: Draft transfer rate depends on connected network types, loading points, filters, buffers, power where required, staff, route condition and destination capacity.

construction.description: 7-9 stages, with manual cart transfer active before powered sorting and advanced network links.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when routes intersect, hauling labour is high or storage/production has persistent blocked flow. It pauses safely when destinations are full.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Between industrial sites and warehouses with enough route/turning clearance. It should not obstruct public streets or bypass settlement ownership.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Freight Depot, Automated Sorting Hub, Rail Exchange, Portal Freight Interface or Regional Logistics Nexus.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must prove directional flow, buffers, route/network compatibility, filters, ownership, maintenance and blocked-output behaviour.

definitions.purpose: Provides higher-output controllable power for town industry, pumping, lighting and automation, with visible fuel, heat, pressure, maintenance and pollution trade-offs.

capacity.description: Draft output depends on generator modules, fuel, water/cooling, pressure/heat, efficiency, staff, transmission and safety limits.

outputs.description: grid telemetry and emergency reserve when buffered

construction.description: 9-11 stages: heavy foundation; boiler/generator; fuel/water; transmission; control; ventilation/waste; safety; commissioning.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when renewable/manual power cannot meet sustained demand. It creates maintenance and fuel demand and should shut down before normal overload becomes catastrophic.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Industrial or utility district with fuel/water logistics and separation from dense housing. Pollution, noise and strategic threat affect site choice.

definitions.upgrade_notes: High-Efficiency Plant, Multi-Generator Station, Hybrid Mana Generator, District Power Station or Regional Grid source.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must prove complete fuel-water-power-waste chain, pressure relief, controls, maintenance, safe access, output limits and authoritative energy accounting.

definitions.purpose: Scales crop production through irrigation, powered tools, controlled climate, logistics, golem support or magic while retaining soil, seed, water, season and maintenance rules.

capacity.description: Draft crop area, cycles and yield depend on valid farm beds, light/climate, water, seeds, fertility, power/mana, machine modules, staff and output storage.

jobs.description: mage/alchemist for magical branch and hauler

outputs.description: research data and reduced labour per unit

construction.description: 8-10 stages, with manual beds and water active before automation, climate control and advanced modules.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when food demand, climate, land scarcity or specialist crops justify capital and utility cost. It fails on water, power, disease, blocked output or climate-control loss.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Suitable land or constructed greenhouse parcel with water/logistics. Climate control can reduce but not erase all biome constraints.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Industrial Greenhouse, Magical Crop Sanctuary, Vertical Farm, Golem Farm or Realm Agriculture Facility.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must count real crop beds, prove water/light/climate, access, inputs/outputs, maintenance and declared automation. Decorative glass buildings do not generate food.

definitions.purpose: Coordinates multiple powered production steps, assembly stations and logistics for bulk machine parts, construction components and advanced goods.

capacity.description: Draft lines, batch throughput and product families depend on floor modules, power, recipes, buffers, logistics, operators, maintenance, quality controls and output demand.

construction.description: 10-14 stages or subprojects; one production line may activate before the full hall is complete.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when city demand and supply chains justify scale. The planner penalises a factory without stable inputs, power, output markets or maintenance labour.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Industrial district with heavy logistics, power, fire/emergency routes and separation from housing. Expansion corridors and district services are important.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Specialised Factory, Magitech Assembly Hall, Regional Production Complex, Golem-Integrated Factory or 20F industrial campus.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must declare supported product families, prove line flow, buffers, power, maintenance, staff safety, output demand and deterministic transactions.

definitions.purpose: Builds, charges, assigns and maintains specialised constructed workers under explicit ownership, allowed zones, task profiles, laws and social consequences.

capacity.description: Draft golem assembly, active labour slots and charge capacity depend on workshops, cores, materials, mana/power, controllers, specialists, storage and maintenance.

jobs.description: ethicist/law officer where relevant and guard

construction.description: 9-12 stages, with repair/charging functions activating before full new-golem assembly.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected after research, materials, law and sustained labour need. It must not make named NPCs irrelevant and may create unemployment, fear, faction or rebellion consequences.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Industrial/magical district with safe test space and strong ownership controls. Cultures may welcome, restrict or reject golem labour.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Specialist Golem Yard, Regional Labour Command, Siege/Construction Golem Annex, Ethical Civic Golem Service or forbidden construct branch.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must declare construct types, task limits, ownership, allowed zones, charge/fuel, emergency shutdown, control security and forbidden flags.

definitions.display_name: Regional Power or Mana Grid Control
definitions.purpose: Coordinates multiple power and mana sources, storage, priorities, districts and emergency isolation across a capital or region without creating energy from nothing.

capacity.description: Draft network scale depends on connected sources, transmission, substations, storage, operators, redundancy, control throughput, security and regional infrastructure.

outputs.description: emergency shutdown and regional planning data

construction.description: 12+ staged subprojects: control centre; communications; source links; storage; substations; security; redundancy; commissioning.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected only after a capital has multiple networks whose unmanaged failures or competition create regional risk. It adds coordination, not raw generation.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Capital utility/governance complex with protected access, redundant routes and links to district/region substations. It is a strategic raid and sabotage target.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Realm Grid Command, Leyline Network Authority, Portal-Energy Coordination or 20F civilisation-scale power nexus.
definitions.player_blueprint_validation: Must bind to actual networks, preserve source/load conservation, prove priorities, isolation, redundancy, authority, multiplayer permissions and persistent fault history.

definitions.purpose: Coordinates one or more farm households, fields, barn/animal areas, storage, water and access as a terrain-adaptive production cluster rather than a single pasted farm model.

capacity.description: Cluster output is the sum of functioning component buildings and plots, modified by travel, water, soil, storage, staffing, animals, weather and route access. The plan itself produces no food.

outputs.description: by-products and visible rural settlement identity

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when provisions demand, suitable land and workers justify a coordinated rural cluster. It adapts or rejects sites with poor soil, unsafe distance, no water or route conflict.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Fertile or culture-suitable terrain with water, sunlight/climate, safe access and enough expansion. It should not place animals or waste upstream of public water or block future settlement routes.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Agricultural Hamlet, Irrigated Farmstead, Orchard/Vineyard Cluster, Ranch, Automated Farm Cluster, Magical Crop Sanctuary or regional estate.
definitions.culture_and_style: Mixed family farm, communal longfields, terrace farm, wetland rice cluster, orchard estate, dwarven fungus farm, fae living grove, desert irrigation compound or floating greenhouse farm.

definitions.purpose: Coordinates market, civic, notice, social and route functions around a public space that can grow from village stalls into a formal town centre.

capacity.description: Trade and civic capacity comes from functioning market, hall, storage, access, staff, public-space and safety components. Open space alone grants morale and event value only when usable and connected.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when dispersed trade, public requests and civic travel need a shared centre. It becomes strained through crowding, blocked deliveries, poor sanitation, unsafe routes or insufficient storage.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Central or highly connected parcel with room for crowds, deliveries and future buildings. Heavy freight should use service access rather than crossing pedestrian space where possible.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Town Market and Civic District, Covered Bazaar, Merchant Forum, Festival Square, Canal Market, Civic Plaza or culture-specific central precinct.
definitions.culture_and_style: Village green, covered bazaar, clan moot market, dwarven trade cavern, fae seasonal clearing, desert caravan square, harbour market or vertical city atrium.

definitions.purpose: Coordinates workshops, industry, storage, freight, worker access, hazard separation and expansion so production scales without scattering incompatible buildings through housing.

capacity.description: District output is aggregated from real workplaces and networks. The template reduces travel and enables shared services but does not create abstract production.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when production buildings compete for land, routes and utilities or hazards threaten mixed settlement areas. It is rejected if staffing, logistics, buffers or waste handling are impossible.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Downwind/downstream or otherwise safely separated according to industry while still connected to housing, warehouse and trade. Terrain, water, resource deposits and existing culture affect form.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Artisan Quarter, Foundry District, Magitech Industry District, Harbour Industry, Underground Works, Clean Production District or regional manufacturing zone.
definitions.culture_and_style: Medieval artisan lanes, canal industry, dwarven forge district, forest craft grove, desert kiln quarter, steamworks, arcane industry terrace or vertical factory district.

definitions.purpose: Coordinates mixed housing, local services, paths, public space and future expansion while allowing culture, terrain and player style to determine actual architecture and density.

capacity.description: Housing and service capacity is the sum of functioning homes and facilities, modified by access, utilities, safety, overcrowding, travel and district condition. The plan itself creates no beds.

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when housing demand, travel distance or unplanned sprawl requires coordinated parcels and services. It can remain low density where culture or terrain prefers it.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Safe and reasonably connected terrain with access to work and civic services. Avoid heavy hazard exposure, flood zones, unstable magical sites and freight routes through local public spaces.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Dense Urban Quarter, Garden District, Worker Housing District, Noble/Administrative Quarter, Mixed-Use Neighbourhood, Underground Residential District or floating neighbourhood.
definitions.culture_and_style: Row-house quarter, courtyard district, clan compounds, terraced hillside homes, forest canopy village, dwarven residential cavern, canal neighbourhood, desert shaded lanes or floating platforms.

definitions.purpose: Coordinates layered walls, gates, towers, command, refuge, strategic storage, patrols and optional wards as a city defence system built from real structures and network segments.

capacity.description: Defence is calculated from actual coverage, readiness, stores, staffing, routes, condition, sightlines, gate control, refuge and redundancy. A closed ring of decorative walls does not guarantee safety.

outputs.description: siege resilience and visible city identity

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when city value, threat, faction conflict or strategic position justifies major defence. High cost, maintenance and political symbolism prevent it from being an automatic stage requirement.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Adapts to terrain, waterways, cliffs, existing roads and districts. Must preserve trade, evacuation and future expansion rather than enclosing the city into an unusable trap.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Capital Citadel, Star Fortress, Mountain Gate Complex, Harbour Defence, Layered Ward Perimeter, Floating Bastion or culture-specific defensive landscape.
definitions.culture_and_style: Stone city walls, earthwork ramparts, dwarven mountain gate, living thorn perimeter, canal defence, desert citadel, ward lattice, floating barrier or distributed hill forts.

definitions.purpose: Provides a reusable campus-planning framework for a hospital complex, university or another multi-building specialist institution with shared grounds, utilities, housing, logistics and expansion.

capacity.description: The campus coordinates access, shared services and expansion. Medical, education or research capacity still comes from functioning component definitions.

outputs.description: teaching/recovery environment and coherent institutional identity

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when one anchor complex is constrained by land, support services, traffic or future expansion. It is not required merely because the city owns a clinic or school.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Large city parcel or multiple linked parcels with reliable transit, utilities and future growth. Hospital variants prioritise emergency access; university variants prioritise public/student movement and research safety.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Teaching Hospital Campus, Grand University, Arcane Research Campus, Military Medical Academy, Distributed City Campus or realm-specific institute.
definitions.culture_and_style: Collegiate courtyards, pavilion hospital, monastery campus, forest learning grove, subterranean institute, canal medical campus, floating academy or distributed urban campus.

definitions.purpose: Coordinates multiple regional transport and freight modes around storage, customs, distribution and passenger access without treating all movement as one magical inventory.

capacity.description: Throughput is limited by each real mode, loading point, storage buffer, staff, route, ownership, power and destination. The nexus improves transfers but cannot exceed its weakest connections.

outputs.description: trade growth and reduced long-distance hauling

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected when trade, travel and freight are blocked by disconnected terminals, repeated transfers or warehouse congestion. It is conditional on genuine regional routes and demand.
planner.placement_and_utilities: City edge, harbour, river, rail corridor or major road intersection with enough land and safe separation from housing. It must connect into city streets without sending heavy freight through pedestrian centres.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Capital Transit Nexus, Multimodal Port, Portal Freight Nexus, Skyport Logistics Complex, Regional Caravan Hub or subterranean rail exchange.
definitions.culture_and_style: Caravan crossroads, canal port, rail depot city, dwarven underground exchange, desert trade oasis, harbour metropolis, portal-linked freight court or vertical sky transit hub.

definitions.display_name: City-Wide Ward Core or Portal Nexus
definitions.purpose: Creates a civilisation-scale magical network through either a city-wide defensive ward core or a multi-station portal nexus. The two branches share project governance and network rules but have different components and risks.

capacity.description: Ward protection or portal throughput is derived from functioning subprojects, source energy, relays/stations, operators, condition, security and district coverage. The megaproject record adds coordination, not free capacity.

outputs.description: story access and major political consequences

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected only after capital governance, stable energy, specialists, district infrastructure and story/faction gates. Costs require automation, contracts, trade and long-term construction.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Capital-scale network across several protected sites. It must account for districts, terrain, leylines, threat, evacuation, ownership and sabotage rather than hiding all function inside one tower.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Regional Ward Network, Inter-City Portal Network, Realm Transit Authority, World Shield component or Leyline Crown integration.
definitions.culture_and_style: Central crystal ward, ring of runic towers, living-tree protective lattice, dwarven resonance grid, grand portal concourse, mirror-gate network, celestial arch system or shadow-threshold authority.

definitions.purpose: Supports a persistent elevated or floating district and/or major air-travel terminal through physical anchors, lift, utilities, logistics, evacuation and maintenance rather than a free-floating decorative platform.

capacity.description: Supported mass/parcel capacity, berth throughput and utility service are bounded by anchors, power/mana, redundancy, weather, maintenance, logistics and evacuation. Added buildings consume real capacity.

outputs.description: unusual housing/industry and access to high-altitude or floating content

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected only when metropolis density, technology/magic, air routes or story goals justify extreme cost and risk. Failure may force evacuation, controlled descent, isolation or catastrophic regional events under severe conditions.
planner.placement_and_utilities: Requires clear airspace and compatible terrain/leyline/technology. Ground anchors and approach routes must avoid crushing existing districts, blocking flight or creating impossible evacuation.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Floating Residential District, Sky Industry, Airship Capital Port, Mobile Platform, Celestial Observatory City or inter-realm aerial nexus.
definitions.culture_and_style: Rune-lifted island, chained sky citadel, crystal buoyancy platform, giant living canopy, dwarven suspended cavern, airship tower, celestial ring or storm-riding city.

definitions.purpose: Represents a culture-defining civilisation achievement with bounded regional or world-state effects. The Leyline Crown is one branch; other cultures may build a world tree sanctuary, colossal archive, ancestral mountain, celestial forge or comparable wonder.

capacity.description: Effects are authored, bounded and dependent on completed subprojects, maintenance, staffing, resources, ownership and world state. A wonder can provide prestige and one or more major services but cannot solve all seven needs.

outputs.description: story progression and a persistent world landmark

planner.triggers_and_failures: Selected through capital status, culture story, major research, rare materials and political consensus or conquest. Rival factions may support, sabotage, contest or attempt to claim it.
planner.placement_and_utilities: A unique strategic and symbolic site selected through culture, terrain, history, leylines, faction politics and world events. It should reshape planning but not invalidate surrounding settlements.

definitions.upgrade_notes: Wonders normally evolve through restoration, additional wings, attunement, cultural succession, realm linkage or corruption/cleansing rather than a simple linear tier.
definitions.culture_and_style: Leyline Crown, World Tree Sanctuary, Grand Archive of Ages, Colossal Golem Foundry, Celestial Orrery, Ancestral Mountain Hall, Eternal Beacon, Dream Spire, Ocean Heart or culture-authored player wonder.
